self:Emit("Died", "lava")

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.GetSt.documentation:
GetState returns whether an `InputAction` is pressed, or for a `Direction2D` action its vector (+Y up, length 0 to 1). It returns false or the zero vector while the action or its `InputContext` is off. Only client scripts can call it.

Client only.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.GetSt.code_sample:
-- Client script: print while the player holds Left Shift.
local gameplay = Instance.new("InputContext")
local sprint = Instance.new("InputAction")
sprint.Parent = gameplay
local shift = Instance.new("InputBinding")
shift.KeyCode = game.Input.Key.LeftShift
shift.Parent = sprint

function Update(dt: number)
    if sprint:GetState() then
        print("sprinting")
    end
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.GetSt.documentation: GetStateEnabled returns whether a character enters a movement state by itself. Every state is enabled until `SetStateEnabled` turns it off.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.GetSt.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
print(npc:GetStateEnabled("Jumping")) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.GetSw.documentation: GetSwingTwistJoint returns the limits, anchor and axes of the swing-twist joint, or nil when there is none.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.GetSw.deprecation: Read the `SwingTwistJoint` properties such as Anchor.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.GetTo.documentation: GetTool returns the tool the character holds, or with `slot`, the tool in that hotbar slot. It returns nil when there is none.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.GetTo.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc:EquipTool(Instance.new("Tool"))
npc:UnequipTools()
print(assert(npc:GetTool(1)).Name) -- prints Tool

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.GetVi.documentation: GetVisionCone returns the range, field of view in degrees, eye height offset and collision group bitmask of the instance's vision cone.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Graph.documentation: GraphOffset is how far a graph canvas is panned, in pixels.
GraphZoom is the zoom of a graph canvas.
GraphZoomMax is the highest zoom the mouse wheel reaches.
GraphZoomMin is the lowest zoom the mouse wheel reaches.
GraphZoomStep is the zoom factor of one mouse wheel notch.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Gravi.documentation: GravityScale multiplies the world's gravity for this body. 1 is normal gravity, 0 is none, and a negative value pulls the body up.
GravityVector is the acceleration in units/s² that replaces world Gravity for this character.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.GridL.documentation: GridLineColor3 is the color of the lines between table cells.
GridLineThickness is the width in pixels of the lines between table cells; 0 draws none.
GridLineTransparency is the transparency of the lines between table cells, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.GripS.documentation: GripSize is the size in pixels of the square resize handle in a window's corner.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Group.documentation: GroupTransparency fades the element and every element under it, from 0 (as authored) to 1 (invisible), including an open popup, menu, dropdown panel or dialog. On a `SurfaceGui` or `BillboardGui` it fades the whole canvas. An element at 1 still takes the pointer; set `Visible` to false to stop it.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Handl.documentation: HandlesColor3 is the color of the 3D handles.
HandlesFaces is a bitmask of the bounding box faces that show handles: bits 0 to 5 are Right (+X), Top (+Y), Back (+Z), Left (-X), Bottom (-Y) and Front (-Z). 63 shows all six.
HandlesStyle is the look of the move handles: `"Resize"` draws ball pins and `"Movement"` draws arrows.
HandlesTransparency is the transparency of the 3D handles.
HandlesType is whether the handles move the instance along each axis (`"Translation"`) or turn it about each axis with rings (`"Rotation"`).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.HasCo.documentation: HasComponent returns true when the instance has the component or Pair.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.HasCo.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
print(self:HasComponent("Light")) -- prints false
self:AddComponent("Light")
print(self:HasComponent("Light")) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Heade.documentation: HeaderCell, when true, makes the grid cell look and work as a clickable column header.
HeaderColor3 is the color of the header bar of a collapsible section.
HeaderHeight is the height in pixels of a collapsible section's header bar. A collapsed section shrinks to this height; values below 0 count as 0.
HeaderTransparency is the transparency of a collapsible section's header bar.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Healt.documentation: Health is the character's health. At 0 the character enters the `"Dead"` state at the next physics step. `Health` is on the character root, so to hurt a body part's character, call TakeDamage on the part or write `Health` on its Character.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Healt.code_sample:
-- Server script: heal a character by 25 without going past MaxHealth.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc:TakeDamage(10)
npc.Health = math.min(npc.Health + 25, npc.MaxHealth)
print(npc.Health) -- prints 100

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.HighV.documentation: HighValue is the step of the upper thumb of a two-thumb range slider, from 0 to `Steps - 1`. Dragging never puts it below the lower thumb.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Highl.documentation: HighlightColor3 is the background color of a menu item or dropdown entry under the pointer.
HighlightTransparency is the transparency of the background of a menu item or dropdown entry under the pointer.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Hinge.documentation: HingeAnchor is the pivot of the hinge, in units in this part's frame.
HingeAxis is the direction the hinge turns around, in this part's frame.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.HipHe.documentation: HipHeight is how high, in units, the bottom of the torso stands above the ground.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Hit.documentation:
Hit fires during each physics step for each body this part's collider hit, with the other instance, the contact position, the contact normal and the relative speed in units per second.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Hit.code_sample:
-- Server script in a floor part: print how hard a crate lands on it.
self.Anchored = true
self.Hit:Connect(function(other: Instance, position: vector, normal: vector, speed: number)
    if speed > 20 then
        print(other.Name, math.round(speed))
    end
end)

local crate = Instance.new("Part")
crate.Name = "Crate"
crate.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
crate.Parent = game.World

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.HitSl.documentation: HitSlopBottom is how many points below the element's box the pointer still hits it, without changing drawing or layout; values below 0 count as 0. Writing it adds the `UIHitSlop` component.
HitSlopLeft is how many points left of the element's box the pointer still hits it; see HitSlopBottom for behavior.
HitSlopRight is how many points right of the element's box the pointer still hits it; see HitSlopBottom for behavior.
HitSlopTop is how many points above the element's box the pointer still hits it; see HitSlopBottom for behavior.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Hover.documentation: HoverImage is the asset id of the image shown in place of `Image` while the pointer is over the element and not pressing it. `"0"` keeps `Image`.

Hovered fires on the client with true when a pointer enters this control and false when it leaves.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Hover.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Parent = screen

button.Hovered:Connect(function(entered)
    button.TextTransparency = if entered then 0 else 0.3
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Hue.documentation: Hue is the hue picked in a color picker, from 0 to 1 around the color wheel: red through green and blue back to red. Values outside 0 to 1 wrap.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.IconA.documentation: IconAlign is the side of the text the icon goes on: `"Left"`, `"Right"`, `"Top"` or `"Bottom"`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.IconG.documentation: IconGap is the gap in pixels between the icon and the text.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.IconS.documentation: IconSize is the width and height in pixels of the icon.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Image.documentation: Image is the asset id of the image drawn over the element's box. `"0"` draws none.
ImageColor3 tints the image: each pixel is multiplied by this color.
ImageRectOffset is the top-left corner, in texture pixels, of the region of the texture the image shows. With ImageRectSize it picks one sprite of a sprite sheet.
ImageRectSize is the size, in texture pixels, of the region of the texture the image shows. A zero side shows the whole texture.
ImageRotation turns the image clockwise by this many degrees about the element's center. Layout, clicks and children do not turn.
ImageTransparency is the transparency of the image, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Inden.documentation: Indent is how far, in pixels, each level of a tree view moves its children to the right.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Induc.documentation: InducedDragFactor is the drag coefficient a wing adds per squared lift coefficient: `C_D = ZeroLiftDrag + InducedDragFactor * C_L ^ 2`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Inner.documentation: InnerAngle is the half-angle, in radians from 0 to 1.57, of the fully lit center of a spotlight. Between `InnerAngle` and OuterAngle the light fades to nothing.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Input.documentation:
InputMove lets the local character walk and jump with the movement keys, the left stick and an `InputAction` that Drives `"Move"` or `"Jump"`. It works only on the client's default camera, game.World.Camera, which starts with it true.

Client only.

InputSteer lets the mouse, the camera keys, the right stick and touch steer the `CameraOrbit` or `CameraFly` rig on this camera. The default camera starts with it true; set it to false to steer the rig from a script alone.

Client only.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Inset.documentation: InsetEdge is the screen edge this element keeps clear for elements that set ScreenInsets: `"Top"`, `"Right"`, `"Bottom"` or `"Left"`. Only a visible element on the screen canvas reserves space.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Inten.documentation: Intensity is the brightness of a point light or spotlight, from 0 to 1000, multiplied by LightColor.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Inver.documentation: InverseTransformDirection turns a world direction into the instance's own frame.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Inver.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 90, 0)
local d = self:InverseTransformDirection(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0))
print(math.round(d.z)) -- prints 1

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Inver.documentation: InverseTransformPoint turns a world position into a position in the instance's own frame.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Inver.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Position = Vector3.new(10, 0, 0)
print(self:InverseTransformPoint(Vector3.new(12, 3, 0))) -- prints 2, 3, 0

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.IsAli.documentation: IsAlive returns true until the instance is destroyed, then false.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.IsAli.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local coin = Instance.new("Part")
coin.Parent = game.World
coin:Destroy()
print(coin:IsAlive()) -- prints false

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.IsDes.documentation: IsDescendantOf returns true when the instance is below `ancestor` in the tree. Every live instance is a descendant of `game.World`; a destroyed one is a descendant of nothing.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.IsDes.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local box = Instance.new("Part")
box.Parent = self
print(box:IsDescendantOf(self)) -- prints true
print(box:IsDescendantOf(game.World)) -- prints true
box:Destroy()
print(box:IsDescendantOf(game.World)) -- prints false

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.IsFoc.documentation:
IsFocused returns true while this text box has keyboard focus.

Client only.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.IsFoc.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
box.Parent = screen
if box:IsFocused() then
    box:ReleaseFocus()
else
    box:CaptureFocus()
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.IsRoo.documentation: IsRoot marks this instance as an accessory root; its descendants are placed relative to it. When false, `Attachment` marks a character socket.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Itali.documentation: Italic, when true, slants the text by 14 degrees.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.ItemC.documentation: ItemCount is the number of items in a long scrolling list, counting those off screen. The list reuses its children to show only the items in view.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.ItemH.documentation: ItemHeight is the height in pixels of every item of a long list. Below 1, children are not reused.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.ItemS.documentation:
ItemShown fires on the client when an item scrolls into view, with the reused child and the item's 1-based index.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.ItemS.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
list.ItemCount = 500
list.Parent = screen
for _ = 1, 11 do
    Instance.new("TextLabel").Parent = list
end

list.ItemShown:Connect(function(item, index)
    item.Text = "Player " .. index
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Joint.documentation: Joint is where on the torso a limb attaches in its rest pose, in units in the torso's frame.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.JumpP.documentation: JumpPower is the speed, in units/s, a jump from the ground gives the character along `UpDirection`.
JumpPowerScale multiplies JumpPower for jumps in the air.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Justi.documentation: Justify places the run of children along the stacking axis of a list: `"Start"`, `"Center"` or `"End"`. A `"Grow"` child fills the spare space, so Justify does nothing.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.KeyCo.documentation: KeyCode is the Input.Key or gamepad button on an `InputBinding` that presses its `Parent` action. 0 binds no key. On a `Direction2D` action only `Input.Key.Thumbstick1` and `Input.Key.Thumbstick2` work here; use Up, Down, Left and Right for keys.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Keybi.documentation: Keybind is the Settings.Keybind action whose input an `InputBinding` follows, so the player's rebinds in the menu apply to it. It works only on a `Bool` action. A wheel turn fires `Pressed` and `Released` once on each frame the wheel turns.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Keybi.code_sample:
-- Client script: react to the player's Player List key, whatever it is.
local keys = Instance.new("InputContext")
local toggle = Instance.new("InputAction")
toggle.Parent = keys
local binding = Instance.new("InputBinding")
binding.Keybind = "PlayerList"
binding.Parent = toggle

toggle.Pressed:Connect(function()
    print("toggle the player list")
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.KnobC.documentation: KnobColor3 is the color of a toggle switch's knob.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.KnobI.documentation: KnobImage is the asset id of the image on a toggle switch's knob. `"0"` draws a plain knob in `KnobColor3`.
KnobInset is the gap in pixels between a toggle switch's track and knob.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.KnobT.documentation: KnobTransparency is the transparency of a toggle switch's knob, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Label.documentation: LabelText is text drawn centered in a separator line, splitting it in two. An empty string draws a plain line.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Layer.documentation: Layer orders decals on the same face of a part, from -128 to 127. A higher layer draws in front, but every layer at -1 or below draws as -1, and every layer at 2 or above as 2.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Layou.documentation: LayoutOrder is the order of an element among its siblings in a list or grid: lower numbers come first, and equal numbers keep the order they were added in.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Left.documentation: Left is the Input.Key on an `InputBinding` that adds -1 on X to a `Direction2D` action while held. 0 binds no key.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.LiftS.documentation: LiftSlope is the lift coefficient a wing gains per radian of angle of attack (the angle between the airflow and the chord): `C_L = LiftSlope * angle` up to `StallAngle`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Light.documentation: LightColor is the sRGB color of a point light or spotlight.
LightShadowOff, when true, stops a point light or spotlight from casting shadows. At most 4 point lights and 8 spotlights cast shadows in a frame; the others light without them.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Limit.documentation: LimitsMax is the upper angle limit of the hinge in degrees when `UseLimits` is true.
LimitsMin is the lower angle limit of the hinge in degrees when `UseLimits` is true.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.LineC.documentation: LineColor3 is the color of a separator's line.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.LineH.documentation: LineHeight is the spacing of text lines as a multiple of the font's line spacing, from 1 to 3.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.LineT.documentation: LineThickness is the thickness in pixels of a separator's line.
LineTransparency is the transparency of a separator's line.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Linea.documentation: LinearDamping is the drag that slows the body's movement. 0 is no drag.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.LinkF.documentation: LinkFrom is the graph port where a wire starts.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.LinkR.documentation:
LinkRequested fires on the client when the player drags between ports on a node graph.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.LinkR.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local graph = Instance.new("Frame")
graph:AddComponent("UIGraph")
graph.Parent = screen
for x = 0, 1 do
    local node = Instance.new("Frame")
    node.Parent = graph
    node.UIRect.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(250 * x, 0)
    local port = Instance.new("Frame")
    port:AddComponent("UIGraphPort")
    port.Parent = node
end
graph.LinkRequested:Connect(function(from, to)
    local wire = Instance.new("Frame")
    wire.LinkFrom = from
    wire.LinkTo = to
    wire.Parent = graph
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.LinkT.documentation: LinkTo is the graph port where a wire ends.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.LinkU.documentation: LinkUrl is the `http://` or `https://` address the button opens in the player's browser. Setting it underlines the button's text.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Local.documentation: LocalOrientation is the rotation of the instance relative to its nearest positioned ancestor, as Euler angles in degrees: (pitch, yaw, roll), applied in YXZ order. Without a positioned ancestor, it is the last value written, or (0, 0, 0), and a write does not turn the instance. Like Orientation, it takes degrees; write radian vectors from the `rotation` library to LocalRotationVector.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Local.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local arm = Instance.new("Part")
arm.Parent = self
self.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 90, 0)
arm.LocalOrientation = Vector3.new(0, 45, 0)
print(math.round(arm.Orientation.y)) -- prints 135

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Local.documentation: LocalPivotTo turns the instance to `rotation` in the frame of its nearest positioned ancestor and moves it so that its own point `pivot` is at `position` in that frame. Without `pivot`, it sets LocalPosition and LocalRotationVector.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Local.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: tip a lid open on its back edge.
local lid = Instance.new("Part")
lid.Parent = self
local hingeOnLid = Vector3.new(0, 1, 1)
local hingeOnSelf = Vector3.new(0, 2, 1)
lid:LocalPivotTo(hingeOnSelf, rotation.axis(Vector3.xAxis, math.rad(90)), hingeOnLid)
print(math.round(lid.LocalPosition.y)) -- prints 3

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Local.documentation: LocalPosition is the offset of the instance from its nearest positioned ancestor, in units. Without a positioned ancestor, it is the last value written, or (0, 0, 0), and a write does not move the instance.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Local.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local lamp = Instance.new("Part")
lamp.Parent = self
lamp.LocalPosition = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)

self.Position = Vector3.new(10, 0, 0)
print(lamp.Position.y) -- prints 3

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Local.documentation: LocalRotationVector is the rotation of the instance relative to its nearest positioned ancestor, as an axis-angle vector in radians like the ones the `rotation` library makes. A read gives an angle from 0 to pi, so a longer turn reads back as the same rotation about the opposite axis. Without a positioned ancestor, a write does not turn the instance.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Local.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local arm = Instance.new("Part")
arm.Parent = self
arm.LocalRotationVector = rotation.axis(Vector3.yAxis, math.rad(270))
print(math.round(math.deg(arm.LocalRotationVector.y))) -- prints -90

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Local.documentation: LocalSpin is the angular velocity in radians per second of an assembly member around its parent part, in that parent's frame. The server turns the member every physics step and clients turn it from the rate, so a fan or wheel spins smoothly. If a script writes the rotation every step instead, the part looks slower or reversed on clients above 1800 rpm.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Local.code_sample:
-- Server script in a fan blade inside an assembly Model.
self.LocalSpin = Vector3.new(0, 2 * math.pi, 0) -- one turn per second

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Locke.documentation: Locked stops Studio's viewport clicks and box selection from selecting the instance or anything under it. It does not change the game.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Longi.documentation: LongitudinalStiffness is the forward grip a tire gains per unit of slip ratio, as a multiple of its load. A stiffer tire reaches `PeakFriction`, and starts to spin or lock, at less slip.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.LookA.documentation: LookAt turns the instance to face a world position. By default its -Z axis faces the target, as a camera does; pass `true` as `useModelFront` to point its +Z axis instead. When the instance is at the target or `up` is zero, it prints an error to Output without turning or stopping the script.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.LookA.code_sample:
-- Server script in a turret part.
local target = Vector3.new(0, 0, -10)
self:LookAt(target, Vector3.yAxis, true)
local front = self:TransformDirection(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
print(math.round(front.z)) -- prints -1

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Loope.documentation: Looped starts the clip again each time it ends, so Playing stays true. Setting it to false while the sound plays lets the current pass finish.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Lower.documentation: LowerTranslation is the shortest `Distance` the rope motor reels in to. The motor stops there.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Margi.documentation: MarginBottom is the space in pixels inside the bottom edge of a list.
MarginLeft is the space in pixels inside the left edge of a list.
MarginRight is the space in pixels inside the right edge of a list.
MarginTop is the space in pixels inside the top edge of a list.

Margins is the space in pixels inside the left, top, right and bottom edges of a list or grid. On a list it reads and writes MarginLeft, MarginTop, MarginRight and MarginBottom. On an element with neither layout, writing it adds a grid layout.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Marke.documentation:
MarkerReached fires when an animation playing on this character passes a named marker. The callback receives the clip name and the marker name.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Marke.code_sample:
-- Client script: print each marker the local character's clips pass.
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player and player.Character
if character then
    character.MarkerReached:Connect(function(clip: string, marker: string)
        print(clip, marker)
    end)
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Mater.documentation: Material is the name of the material this entity draws with, or `""` when it has none. A write takes a material name or the asset id that `game.Materials.DefineMaterial` returns; a read gives the name. On a character, every body part without its own material draws with the character's material.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MaxAc.documentation: MaxActivationDistance is the base click distance in units from a player's character to this part; the radius of the part's bounding sphere is added to it.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MaxDi.documentation: MaxDistance is how far from the camera, in units, the sun casts shadows.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MaxEV.documentation: MaxEV is the highest exposure value, from -6 to 20, that automatic exposure uses, so bright sunlight does not darken the picture too much.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MaxHe.documentation: MaxHealth is the most health the character can have through `TakeDamage`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MaxJu.documentation: MaxJumps is how many times the character can jump in the air before it lands, 0 to 255. It belongs to the `MultiJump` component, which a spawned character lacks, so the character jumps only from the ground. Setting `MaxJumps` or JumpPowerScale adds the component; the character can then jump `1 + MaxJumps` times.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MaxLe.documentation: MaxLength is the most bytes the player can type or paste into the text box, up to 65535; 0 sets no limit. A script that writes `Text` is not cut to the limit.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MaxPo.documentation: MaxPolyphony is the most copies of this sound that play at once, such as overlapping footsteps. When Play would start one more, the oldest copy stops; at 1, Play restarts the sound.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MaxSi.documentation: MaxSize is the largest size layout gives the element; zero sets no limit. MinSize wins when it is larger.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MaxSl.documentation: MaxSlopeAngle is the steepest slope, in degrees, the character walks on. On steeper ground it cannot jump and, by default, slides down.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MaxSt.documentation: MaxSteerTorque is the most torque the steering spring applies to turn a `Steers` wheel. 0 does not limit the spring.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MaxVa.documentation: MaxValue is the highest value of a slider.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Maxim.documentation: MaximumMotorForce is the most force in Newtons the rope motor pulls with.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MenuC.documentation: MenuCheck, when true, makes a menu item keep room at its left edge for a check mark or radio dot.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Mesh.documentation: Mesh is the asset id of a 3D model drawn at the part's `Size` in place of its Type shape. `"0"` draws the shape.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Metal.documentation: MetallicRoughness is the asset id of a texture whose blue channel sets metalness and green channel sets roughness. Metalness 1 looks like bare metal; low roughness is shiny and high roughness is matte. `"0"` uses the material's own settings.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MinEV.documentation: MinEV is the lowest exposure value, from -6 to 20, that automatic exposure uses, so night scenes and dark rooms do not look too bright.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MinSi.documentation: MinSize is the smallest width and height in pixels layout gives the element; a zero side sets no minimum. It wins over MaxSize.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.MinVa.documentation: MinValue is the lowest value of a slider.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Mixed.documentation: Mixed, when true, places a toggle switch's knob in the middle. Clicking clears Mixed and flips `On`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Motor.documentation: MotorForce is the most torque in Newton-meters the hinge motor applies. At 0 the motor does not turn the part.
MotorSpeed is how fast the rope motor changes `Distance`, in units per second. A negative value reels in, a positive value reels out, and 0 stops the motor.
notes: The motor keeps `Distance` between `LowerTranslation` and `UpperTranslation`. A rope longer than `UpperTranslation`, which is 5 by default, jumps to that length when its motor starts.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Motor.code_sample:
-- Server script in a crate that hangs on a rope: winch it up until the rope is 2 units long.
self.LowerTranslation = 2
self.MotorSpeed = -1

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Motor.documentation: MotorTargetVelocity is the speed of the hinge motor in degrees per second. A positive value turns counterclockwise around `HingeAxis`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Mount.documentation:
Mount is where the wheel rests on its `Chassis`, in the chassis's frame. The engine records it when the wheel joint first forms, and the suspension springs back to it. Setting `Chassis` or `Axle` records it again.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Mouse.documentation:
MouseClick fires on the server when a player clicks this instance or one of its descendants within its activation distance. The callback receives the player.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Mouse.code_sample:
-- Server script in a button part: open and close a door on click.
local door = Instance.new("Part")
door.Anchored = true
door.Size = Vector3.new(4, 7, 1)
door.Position = self.Position + Vector3.new(4, 2, 0)
door.Parent = game.World

self:AddComponent("ClickDetector")
self.MouseClick:Connect(function(player: Instance)
    local shut = door.Collider ~= "None"
    door.Collider = if shut then "None" else "Auto"
    door.Transparency = if shut then 0.7 else 0
    print(player.Name .. (if shut then " opened the door" else " closed the door"))
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Multi.documentation: MultiSelectColor3 is the color of the box a player drags to select several elements, and of the highlight behind each selected child.
MultiSelectTransparency is the transparency of the multi-select drag box and the highlight behind each selected child.
MultiSelected, when true, makes the element part of the current multiple selection.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Name.documentation: Name is the name of this instance in the scene tree.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Night.documentation: NightSky is a night texture that the atmosphere sky does not draw.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Night.deprecation: Pick the Starry Night cube under Platform > Skies as the Panorama.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.NoCon.documentation: NoContactFriction makes the character's colliders slide with no friction.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.NoTra.documentation: NoTranslate, when true, shows the element's `Text` as written, never translated to the player's language.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Norma.documentation: Normal is the asset id of a tangent-space normal map, with green pointing up the image as in glTF, so bumps and grooves show without more polygons. `"0"` lights the mesh by its own faces.
NormalCone is a swing limit of the swing-twist joint in degrees. The joint swings within one cone whose half-angle is the larger of `PlaneCone` and NormalCone.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Numbe.documentation: Number is the value of a number field. Player input keeps it between NumberMin and NumberMax.
NumberMax is the highest value the player can enter.
NumberMin is the lowest value the player can enter.
NumberStep is how much a number field changes per drag step or arrow key. 0 lets the value change smoothly.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Occlu.documentation: Occlusion is the asset id of an ambient occlusion texture. Its red channel darkens the ambient light and the shadow fill in creases; local lights are not affected. `"0"` means none.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Occup.documentation:
Occupant is the character sitting on this seat, or nil. The character leaves with the seat's velocity when jumping off.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Occup.code_sample:
-- Server script in a car's seat: a part with a Seat component.
self:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
    local rider = self.Occupant
    print(if rider then rider.Name .. " got in" else "the seat is empty")
end)

while task.wait() do
    self:ApplyForce(Vector3.new(0, 0, -500 * self.SeatInput.Forward))
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.OffCo.documentation: OffColor3 is the color of a toggle switch's track while `On` is false.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.OffIm.documentation: OffImage is the asset id of the image on a toggle switch's track while it is off. `"0"` draws a plain track in `OffColor3`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.OffTr.documentation: OffTransparency is the transparency of a toggle switch's track while it is off, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Offse.documentation: Offset slides the texture by X and Y texture widths along U and V; Z is ignored.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Offse.code_sample:
-- Server script in a conveyor part with a textured material.
self:AddComponent("UvTransform")
local SPEED = 0.5 -- widths per second

function Update(dt: number)
    local x = (self.Offset.X + SPEED * dt) % 1
    self.Offset = Vector3.new(x, 0, 0)
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.On.documentation: On is whether a toggle switch or UIToggleButton is on. Clicking flips it and fires `Activated`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.OnCol.documentation: OnColor3 is the color of a toggle switch's track while `On` is true.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.OnIma.documentation: OnImage is the asset id of the image on a toggle switch's track while it is on. `"0"` draws a plain track in `OnColor3`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.OnTra.documentation: OnTransparency is the transparency of a toggle switch's track while it is on, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Op.documentation: Op is what a core menu setting control does when pressed: `"Show"` shows the current value, `"Previous"` steps back, and `"Next"` steps forward. A control outside the core menu ignores it.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Open.documentation: Open, when true, opens the dropdown's list. A click outside sets it to false.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Optio.documentation: Options is the choices of a dropdown, separated by commas. The chosen entry is the one at SelectedIndex.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Orien.documentation: Orientation is the world rotation of the instance as Euler angles in degrees: (pitch, yaw, roll), applied in YXZ order. A radian vector from the `rotation` library assigned to it raises no error and turns the instance by about 1/57 of the intended angle; convert it with `rotation.to_euler` or write it to RotationVector.
notes: On a camera with `CameraOrbit` or `CameraFly`, a write also sets the rig's `yaw` and `pitch`. While `CameraOrbit` follows a subject, the rig sets `Orientation` every frame; see game.World.Camera.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Orien.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local r = rotation.axis(Vector3.yAxis, math.rad(30))
self.Orientation = rotation.to_euler(r)
print(math.round(self.Orientation.y)) -- prints 30

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Other.documentation: Other is the part this part is welded to. Setting it makes the two parts one body in the pose they have at that moment; setting nil separates them again. The target must be another part with a physics body outside this part's assembly, or the weld does not form.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Other.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: weld a handle on top of it.
local handle = Instance.new("Part")
handle.Position = self.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
handle.Parent = game.World
handle.Other = self

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Outer.documentation: OuterAngle is the half-angle, in radians from 0 to 1.57, of a spotlight's cone, which points along the instance's -Y axis.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Outer.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: a warm spotlight that points down.
self:AddComponent("Light")
self:AddComponent("SpotCone")
self.LightColor = Vector3.new(1, 0.8, 0.5)
self.OuterAngle = math.rad(30)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Owner.documentation: OwnerUserId is the user id of the player who controls this character, or 0. Setting it on the server gives the character to that player: their movement input drives it and `CharacterAdded` fires. Setting it to 0 or another id takes the character from its player.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Owner.code_sample:
-- Server script: after 30 s, give each player without a character one.
task.delay(30, function()
    for player in game.World.Each("Player") do
        if player.Character == nil then
            local character = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
            character.Position = Vector3.new(0, 4, -12)
            character.OwnerUserId = player.UserId
        end
    end
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Page.documentation: Page is the core menu page this element belongs to. The element and everything under it show only while the core menu is on that page.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Panel.documentation: PanelColor3 is the background color of a popup menu or dropdown list.
PanelTransparency is the transparency of a popup menu or dropdown list's background.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Panor.documentation: Panorama is the asset id of a sky texture: a 2:1 equirectangular panorama or a cube texture. `"0"`, or a texture that fails to load, shows BackgroundColor. `AtmosphereSky` draws instead when the instance has it.
PanoramaEnergyMultiplier is the brightness of a panorama sky, from 0 to 128, multiplied by BackgroundEnergyMultiplier.
PanoramaRotation turns a panorama sky around the horizon, in degrees from 0 to 360.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Pants.documentation: Pants is the asset id of the clothing texture on the legs, or `"0"` for none.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Paren.documentation:
Parent is the parent of this instance, or nil for an instance at the top of the place. Assign `game.World` to move an instance to the top. A destroyed instance reads nil, and writing its `Parent` is an error.

Read only at runtime.
notes: The instance keeps its local offset and rotation, so under a positioned parent it moves to that pose in the parent's frame. Call SetParent to keep the world pose instead.
Assigning nil is deprecated and prints a warning once per run.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Paren.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local lamp = Instance.new("Part")
lamp.Parent = self
lamp.Parent = game.World -- moves it to the top of the place
print(lamp.Parent == self) -- prints false

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Part.documentation: Part is which body part this limb is: `"Head"`, `"Torso"`, `"LeftArm"`, `"RightArm"`, `"LeftLeg"` or `"RightLeg"`. It sets where the limb attaches, its collider size, and how animations map onto it.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Passw.documentation: Password, when true, shows asterisks in the text box in place of what the player types. `Text` keeps the real characters.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Pause.documentation: Pause pauses a playing sound and keeps its place in the clip.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Pause.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: pause the loop after 2 seconds.
self:AddComponent("Sound")
self.SoundId = "144115188075855954"
self.Looped = true
self:Play()

task.wait(2)
self:Pause()
print(self.Playing, self.Paused) -- prints false true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Pause.documentation:
Paused is true while the sound is paused partway through. Pause sets it; Resume and Stop clear it.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.PeakF.documentation: PeakFriction is the friction of a tire at its best slip. It mixes with the ground's friction like any part's friction.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Pivot.documentation: Pivot is the negated offset of the limb's joint, in units in the limb's frame.

PivotPoint is the point the element turns and scales about, as a fraction of its size: `0, 0` is the top-left corner and `1, 1` the bottom-right. It applies to Rotation and Scale and moves nothing by itself.
PivotTo turns the instance to the world rotation `rotation` and moves it so that its own point `pivot` is at the world position `position`. Without `pivot`, it sets Position and RotationVector.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Pivot.code_sample:
-- Server script in a door part 4 units wide: swing it open on its left edge.
self.Anchored = true
local hingeOnDoor = Vector3.new(-2, 0, 0)
local hinge = self:TransformPoint(hingeOnDoor)
self:PivotTo(hinge, rotation.axis(Vector3.yAxis, math.rad(90)), hingeOnDoor)
print(math.round(self.Position.z)) -- prints -2

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Place.documentation: PlaceholderColor3 is the color of a text box's PlaceholderText. Until it is written, the placeholder draws in a dim gray.
PlaceholderText is the hint a text box shows while its `Text` is empty and it is not being typed in.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Plane.documentation: PlaneAxis is the reference axis of the swing-twist joint's swing, in the parent part's frame. The default zero vector means `(1, 0, 0)`.
PlaneCone is a swing limit of the swing-twist joint in degrees. The joint swings within one cone whose half-angle is the larger of PlaneCone and `NormalCone`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Play.documentation: Play starts the sound's clip from the beginning. The instance needs a Sound component.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Play.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: play a sound when the script starts.
self:AddComponent("Sound")
self.SoundId = "144115188075855954"
self:Play()
print(self.Playing) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.PlayA.documentation: PlayAnimation plays a clip on the character in place of its walk, idle and jump animations, until StopAnimation. `fade` is the blend time in seconds and defaults to the walk fade; `speed` multiplies the playback rate and defaults to 1.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.PlayA.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
task.wait() -- a new character gets its animator at the next physics step
npc:PlayAnimation("sit", 0.2)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Playb.documentation: PlaybackSpeed scales the speed and pitch of the sound: 2 plays one octave up, 0.5 one octave down. Values below 0.05 play at 0.05, so 0 does not pause the sound.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Playi.documentation:
Playing is true while the sound plays. It turns false when a clip that does not loop ends, on Pause or Stop, and when the audio fails to load.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.PlotC.documentation: PlotColor3 is the color of a plot's lines or bars.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.PlotT.documentation: PlotTransparency is the transparency of a plot's lines or bars.
PlotType is how a plot draws its samples: `"Lines"` joins them with a line, and `"Bars"` draws a bar from zero to each sample.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Popup.documentation: Popup, when true, closes the popup when the player clicks outside it.
PopupOpen, when true, shows the popup panel above the rest of the interface.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.PortC.documentation: PortColor3 is the wire color of a graph port.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.PortT.documentation: PortTransparency is the wire transparency of a graph port.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Posit.documentation: Position is the position of the instance in the world, in units. Descendants move with it. On a user interface element, `Position` is a `UDim2` that places the element in its parent, as UIPosition describes.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Posit.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part with a light above it.
self.Anchored = true
local light = Instance.new("Part")
light.Anchored = true
light.Parent = self
light.Position = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)

self.Position = Vector3.new(10, 0, 0)
print(light.Position.x) -- prints 10

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Prefa.documentation:
PrefabId is the id of the prefab this instance is a copy of, or 0. A linked copy saves as its prefab plus its own edits. See Prefabs.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Press.documentation:
Pressed fires on the client when a mouse button or touch goes down on this control. On an `InputAction`, it fires when one of its bindings starts the action.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Press.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Parent = screen

button.Pressed:Connect(function()
    print("down")
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Press.documentation: PressedImage is the asset id of the image shown in place of `Image` while the button is held down. `"0"` keeps `Image`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Previ.documentation: PreviewAnimation opens an animation preview on the character, which shows one clip at a chosen `time` and `speed`, playing or paused. It returns whether the preview opened.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Previ.code_sample:
-- Server script: show the walk clip half a second in, paused.
local rig = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
task.wait()
print(rig:PreviewAnimation("walk", false, 0.5)) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Prior.documentation: Priority is the order in which `InputContext` instances receive input, highest first. Contexts of the same priority all receive the input.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Progr.documentation: Progress is how full the progress bar is, from 0 to 1, drawn clamped to that range.
ProgressColor3 is the color of a progress bar's fill.
ProgressTrackColor3 is the color of the track behind a progress bar's fill.
ProgressTrackTransparency is the transparency of the track behind a progress bar's fill.
ProgressTransparency is the transparency of a progress bar's fill.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.PushS.documentation:
PushSample adds a number to a UI plot. Once the plot is full, the oldest sample drops off. Only client scripts can call it.

Client only.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.PushS.code_sample:
-- Client script: plot the frame rate.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local plot = Instance.new("Frame")
plot:AddComponent("UIPlot")
plot.Parent = screen

function Update(dt: number)
    plot:PushSample(1 / dt)
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Radio.documentation: Radio, when true, draws a round radio dot in place of a square check mark.
RadioGroup is the number that ties radio buttons together: selecting one unselects the others with the same number.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Range.documentation: Range is how far, in units from 0 to 1000, a point light or spotlight reaches. The light fades to nothing at `Range`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Relea.documentation:
ReleaseFocus takes keyboard focus away from this text box as a click elsewhere does and fires `FocusLost` with the boolean passed, or false when omitted.

Client only.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Relea.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
box.Parent = screen
box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
    print(enterPressed)
end)
box:CaptureFocus()
box:ReleaseFocus(true)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Relea.documentation:
Released fires on the client when a mouse button or touch comes up over this control. On an `InputAction`, it fires when the action ends.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Relea.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Parent = screen

button.Released:Connect(function()
    print("up")
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Remai.documentation: Remaining is how many seconds are left before this instance and everything under it are destroyed. A client counts down only instances it made.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Remai.code_sample:
-- Server script: make a brick that disappears after 5 seconds.
local brick = Instance.new("Part")
brick.Remaining = 5

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Remov.documentation: RemoveComponent removes one or more components or `Tag` pairs from the instance. A component the instance does not have is skipped.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Remov.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:AddComponent("Light", "SpotCone")
self:RemoveComponent("SpotCone", "Light")
print(self:HasComponent("Light")) -- prints false

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Rende.documentation: RenderDisabled, when true, hides the instance everywhere, shadows and decals included. Physics, raycasts and replication still work.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Repea.documentation: RepeatDelay is how many seconds a button or arrow key is held before it repeats every RepeatInterval.
RepeatInterval is the number of seconds between repeats while a button or key stays held.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Resam.documentation: ResampleMode is how image pixels are sampled when the image draws larger or smaller than the texture: `"Default"` blends neighbors, and `"Pixelated"` keeps the square pixels of pixel art.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Resiz.documentation: ResizableColumns, when true, lets players drag the dividers between table columns to resize them.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Resti.documentation: Restitution is the bounciness of the part's surface. 0 does not bounce, 1 bounces back at full speed, and above 1 bounces faster. A part without its own Restitution reads its material's restitution, or 0.3 without a material.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Resum.documentation: Resume plays a paused sound from where it stopped.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Resum.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: pause the loop for 2 seconds, then go on.
self:AddComponent("Sound")
self.SoundId = "144115188075855954"
self.Looped = true
self:Play()

self:Pause()
task.wait(2)
self:Resume()
print(self.Playing) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.RichT.documentation:
RichText, when true, draws `Text` as markup with lowercase `` (weight 700), ``, ``, `
` and the `<` `>` `"` `'` `&` escapes. Markup that does not parse draws as written, and a text box ignores `RichText`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.RichT.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Parent = screen
label.RichText = true
label.Text = 'Score: 10 <font color="#ff4040">-2</font>'

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Right.documentation: Right is the Input.Key on an `InputBinding` that adds +1 on X to a `Direction2D` action while held. 0 binds no key.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.RollO.documentation: RollOffMaxDistance is the distance, in units, past which the sound cannot be heard.
RollOffMinDistance is the distance, in units, within which the sound plays at full volume.

RollOffScale is how fast the sound gets quieter past RollOffMinDistance: the volume is multiplied by `min / (min + RollOffScale * (distance - min))`, where `min` is `RollOffMinDistance`. At 0 the sound keeps full volume out to RollOffMaxDistance.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Rolli.documentation: RollingResistance is the torque against a tire's rolling, as a fraction of its load.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.RootM.documentation: RootMotion adds the root bone's movement in the playing clips to the character's horizontal velocity each frame. It needs Character.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.RopeA.documentation: RopeAnchor is where the rope attaches to this part, in units in its frame.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Rotat.documentation: Rotate turns the instance by an angle in radians around an axis in its own frame.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Rotat.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:Rotate(Vector3.yAxis, math.rad(90))
print(math.round(self.Orientation.y)) -- prints 90

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Rotat.documentation: Rotation turns the element and everything under it clockwise by this many degrees about its PivotPoint, after layout, so the box keeps its place in a list.
RotationVector is the world rotation of the instance as an axis-angle vector in radians like the ones the `rotation` library makes. Descendants turn with it.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Rotat.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.RotationVector = rotation.axis(Vector3.yAxis, math.rad(90))
print(math.round(self.Orientation.y)) -- prints 90

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.RttMs.documentation:
RttMs is the round trip time between the server and this player, in milliseconds, smoothed over recent packets. It reads 0 on clients, which read their own from Session.RttMs.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Sampl.documentation: SampleCount is how many samples a plot keeps across its width, from 1 to 128. When the plot is full, each new sample pushes out the oldest.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Satur.documentation: Saturation is the saturation picked in a color picker, from 0 (gray) to 1 (full color). Dragging left or right changes it.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Scale.documentation: ScaleMax is the value at the top edge of a plot. When `ScaleMax` is at or below ScaleMin, the plot fits its height to its samples.
ScaleMin is the value at the bottom edge of a plot. When `ScaleMin` is at or above ScaleMax, the plot fits its height to its samples.

ScaleType is how the image fills an element of a different size. `"Stretch"` scales it to the element, `"Slice"` keeps the corners at their size (see SliceCenter), `"Tile"` repeats it at TileSize, `"Fit"` fits it inside, and `"Crop"` covers the element and cuts the overflow.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Scree.documentation: ScreenInsets is which core UI screen edges the element stays clear of, from `game.Enum.ScreenInsets`. `"CoreUISafeInsets"` lays the element out in the screen minus every edge reserved with InsetEdge, and `"TopbarSafeInsets"` minus only the top edge. It works only in the screen UI.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Scrol.documentation: ScrollBarMax is the end of a scroll bar's range, in units the script picks.
ScrollBarMin is the start of a scroll bar's range, in units the script picks.
ScrollBarPage is how much of a scroll bar's range shows at once, in the units of ScrollBarMin and ScrollBarMax.
ScrollBarThickness is the width in pixels of the bar a scrolling frame draws while its canvas is taller than the frame. 0 draws none; the wheel and keys still scroll.
ScrollBarValue is the scroll position. Dragging or clicking the bar changes it and keeps it between ScrollBarMin and `ScrollBarMax - ScrollBarPage`.
ScrollFollowing, when true, keeps the frame scrolled to the bottom as children are added or the scroll area grows.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Searc.documentation: SearchBox, when true, shows a clear button at the right end of the text box while it has text. Clicking it sets `Text` to `""`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Selec.documentation: Selectable, when true, lets the arrow keys, d-pad and left stick move the selection onto the element. When it is false, the pointer can still press it.
Selected, when true, makes this radio button the chosen option of its group.
SelectedIndex is the 1-based index, in layout order, of the chosen child item, or 0 for none. The selection highlight draws behind that child. In a tab view it is the open tab.
SelectedTabColor3 is the color of the open tab's button.
SelectedTabTransparency is the transparency of the open tab's button.

SelectionChanged fires on the client when this control gains or loses the keyboard and gamepad selection, `game.Input.Selected`. The callback receives true when the control becomes selected and false when the selection leaves it.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Selec.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Text = "Play"
button.Parent = screen
button.SelectionChanged:Connect(function(selected)
    button.BackgroundTransparency = if selected then 0 else 0.5
end)
game.Input.Selected = button

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Selec.documentation: SelectionColor3 is the color of the highlight behind the selected list item.

SelectionGroup, when true, keeps the arrow keys, d-pad and left stick from moving the selection out of this container, so a player in an inventory window cannot step onto the hotbar behind it. A script write to `game.Input.Selected` can still select outside it.
SelectionRing, when true, draws the blue ring around the element while it is selected. False leaves the selected look to the element, which can draw it from `SelectionChanged`.

SelectionScope is the UI element within which an `InputContext` is active: the context receives input only while `game.Input.Selected` is that element or inside it, or everywhere when nil. A scoped context receives input before every unscoped one, whatever their `Priority`.
notes: An inner `SelectionGroup` stops the scope, so a popup that has the selection turns off the keys of the list it opens from.
With `Sink`, the keys its actions bind go to those actions instead of moving or activating the selection or opening the menu.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Selec.documentation: SelectionStart is the byte position, counted from 1, of the end of the selection opposite the caret in a focused text box, or -1 when nothing is selected or the box has no focus. Writing it selects the text between it and the caret.
SelectionTransparency is the transparency of the highlight behind the selected list item, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetAn.documentation: SetAngularVelocity sets the world angular velocity of the physics body in radians per second.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetAn.deprecation: Attach `AngVelocity` with Instance:AddComponent and write the `AngVelocity` column on World.Query.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetBo.documentation: SetBodyMotion switches the physics body between moving under physics (`"dynamic"`) and moving only where a script puts it (`"kinematic"`).
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetBo.deprecation: Attach or remove the Kinematic component with Instance:AddComponent and Instance:RemoveComponent.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetHe.documentation: SetHearingSense sets how well the instance hears and which collision groups it hears. A mask of 0 hears all groups.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetHe.deprecation: Attach `HearingSense` with Instance:AddComponent and configure fields with World.Query.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetLi.documentation: SetLinearVelocity sets the world velocity of the physics body in units per second.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetPa.documentation: SetParent moves the instance under a new parent and keeps its world pose, unless `keepWorld` is false.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetPa.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local wheel = Instance.new("Part")
wheel.Parent = game.World
wheel.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
wheel:SetParent(self) -- keeps its world position
print(wheel.Position.y) -- prints 10

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetSt.documentation: SetStateEnabled sets whether a character enters a movement state by itself. With `"Jumping"` off it ignores the jump input; with `"GettingUp"` off a character in `"Ragdoll"` or `"FallingDown"` stays down. To keep a character from falling over, turn off both `"Ragdoll"`, which a hard hit causes, and `"FallingDown"`, which tipping too far causes.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetSt.code_sample:
-- Server script: a character that carries a crate cannot jump or fall over.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc:SetStateEnabled("Jumping", false)
npc:SetStateEnabled("Ragdoll", false)
npc:SetStateEnabled("FallingDown", false)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetSw.documentation: SetSwingTwistJoint sets the angle limits, anchor and axes of the instance's swing-twist joint.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetSw.deprecation: Assign the `SwingTwistJoint` properties (Anchor, TwistAxis, PlaneAxis, PlaneCone, NormalCone, TwistMin, TwistMax, FrictionTorque).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetVi.documentation: SetVisionCone sets how far and how wide the instance sees, its eye height (1.5 by default), and which collision groups it sees (0 sees all).
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SetVi.deprecation: Attach `VisionCone` with Instance:AddComponent and configure fields with World.Query.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Setti.documentation: Setting is the player setting a core menu control changes, such as `"Quality"`, `"FieldOfView"` or `"MusicVolume"`. A control outside the core menu ignores it.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Shade.documentation: ShadeFill, when true, lightens the fill of a clickable element under the pointer, and more while pressed.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Shado.documentation: ShadowOff, when true, stops the instance from casting shadows. It still receives shadows.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Shirt.documentation: Shirt is the asset id of the clothing texture on the torso and arms, or `"0"` for none.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Short.documentation: Shortcut is text shown at the right of a menu item, such as `"Ctrl+S"`. It does not bind the key.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Side.documentation: Side is the face of the parent part that a decal shows on: `"Right"` (+X), `"Top"` (+Y), `"Back"` (+Z), `"Left"` (-X), `"Bottom"` (-Y) or `"Front"` (-Z). A parent with a mesh places the decal by the mesh's UVs.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Sink.documentation: Sink stops the keys and UI buttons of an `InputContext`'s enabled actions from reaching lower-priority contexts and the character controls.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Sink.code_sample:
-- Client script: Space fires a jetpack instead of jumping.
local jetpack = Instance.new("InputContext")
jetpack.Sink = true
local thrust = Instance.new("InputAction")
thrust.Parent = jetpack
local space = Instance.new("InputBinding")
space.KeyCode = game.Input.Key.Space
space.Parent = thrust

thrust.Pressed:Connect(function()
    print("thrust")
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Size.documentation: Size is the size of the instance along its local axes in units: (width, height, depth). On a user interface element, `Size` is a `UDim2` relative to its parent, as UISize describes.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SizeM.documentation: SizeModeX is how the element's width is set. `"Fixed"` uses `Size.X`, `"Fit"` fits the width to the children, and `"Grow"` fills the room the parent gives, shared among a list's `"Grow"` children.
SizeModeY is how the element's height is set, as SizeModeX sets the width.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Skybo.documentation: SkyboxBk is the asset id of the back face (+Z) of a six-sided sky. If every face is `"0"` or any face fails to load, the sky shows BackgroundColor. `AtmosphereSky` and `PanoramaSky` draw instead when the instance has either.
SkyboxDn is the asset id of the bottom face (-Y) of a six-sided sky.
SkyboxEnergyMultiplier is the brightness of a six-sided sky, from 0 to 128, multiplied by BackgroundEnergyMultiplier.
SkyboxFt is the asset id of the front face (-Z) of a six-sided sky.
SkyboxLf is the asset id of the left face (-X) of a six-sided sky.
SkyboxRotation turns a six-sided sky around the horizon, in degrees from 0 to 360.
SkyboxRt is the asset id of the right face (+X) of a six-sided sky.
SkyboxUp is the asset id of the top face (+Y) of a six-sided sky.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Slice.documentation: SliceCenter is the stretching middle of a `"Slice"` image, in image pixels. The pixels left of `Min.X`, above `Min.Y`, right of `Max.X` and below `Max.Y` are corners and edges that keep their size.
SliceScale is the size of a `"Slice"` image's corners and edges as a multiple of their image size.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Slide.documentation: SliderFormat is a format string for the slider's value label, with string formatting specifiers for the number. An empty string shows the plain number.
SliderValue is the current value of a slider. Dragging moves it between MinValue and MaxValue and fires `Activated`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Slot.documentation: Slot is the socket an accessory attaches to: `"Hat"`, `"Hair"`, `"Face"`, `"Back"`, `"LeftShoulder"`, `"RightShoulder"`, `"Waist"`, `"Front"` or `"Neck"`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Slots.documentation: Slots is the list of prefab ids in the 10 hotbar slots. A tool without a prefab reads 0 here. On the server, writing it adds or removes the character's tools to match.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SortC.documentation: SortColumn is the column, counted from 0, that a table sorts by, or -1 for none. Clicking a sortable column header changes `SortColumn`; a column that does not exist turns sorting off.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SortD.documentation: SortDescending, when true, sorts the table from highest to lowest.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Sound.documentation: SoundId is the asset id of the audio clip, as a string of digits such as `"144115188075855954"`. Write it in quotes: a Luau number cannot represent every digit, so an unquoted id names a different asset. In Studio, Copy ID on the sound field gives the id, and Import… imports an `.ogg` file.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Spaci.documentation: Spacing is the gap in pixels between a list's children along the direction it stacks them.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Spawn.documentation: SpawnPoint lets characters spawn at this instance's position.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SpinS.documentation: SpinSpeed is the spin in radians per second that the wheel's motor drives the wheel toward, with up to `DriveTorque`. At 0 the motor brakes. The engine limits the spin to 754 radians per second.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Sprin.documentation: SpringDamping is how fast a wheel's suspension stops bouncing. At 1 the wheel settles without bouncing, and at 0 it bounces forever.
SpringFrequency is the stiffness of a wheel's suspension in bounces per second, whatever the masses. At 0 the wheel slides freely within `Travel`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Stall.documentation: StallAngle is the angle of attack in degrees past which a wing's lift coefficient stops growing.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.StarL.documentation: StarLuminance is the star brightness of a night texture that the atmosphere does not draw.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.StarL.deprecation: Pick the Starry Night cube as the Panorama and set PanoramaEnergyMultiplier.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Start.documentation: StartTimer starts or restarts the countdown timer on the instance.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.State.documentation:
State is what the character is doing: `"Running"`, `"FreeFall"`, `"Jumping"`, `"Climbing"`, `"Swimming"`, `"Seated"`, `"Ragdoll"`, `"FallingDown"`, `"GettingUp"`, `"Dead"`, `"PlatformStanding"` or `"Physics"`.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.State.code_sample:
-- Server script: print each state a character enters.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("State"):Connect(function()
    print(npc.State)
end)
npc:ChangeState("Ragdoll")

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.State.documentation:
StateChanged fires on the client when an `InputAction` turns on or off, passing `true` or `false`, or when a `Direction2D` action's vector changes, passing the new vector. A tap within one frame fires it twice, `true` then `false`.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.State.code_sample:
-- Client script: report when the player presses and releases F.
local tools = Instance.new("InputContext")
local flashlight = Instance.new("InputAction")
flashlight.Parent = tools
local f = Instance.new("InputBinding")
f.KeyCode = game.Input.Key.F
f.Parent = flashlight

flashlight.StateChanged:Connect(function(on)
    print(if on then "pressed" else "released")
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Steer.documentation:
Steer is the right input of the character sitting on this seat, from -1 to 1.

Read only at runtime.
SteerLimit is how far in degrees a `Steers` wheel may turn either way. At 0 the wheel stays straight.
SteerTarget is the angle in degrees the steering spring turns a `Steers` wheel toward, within `SteerLimit`.
Steers lets a wheel turn about the chassis's up direction toward `SteerTarget`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Steer.code_sample:
-- Server script in a front wheel: let it steer up to 30 degrees and turn it 20.
self.Steers = true
self.SteerLimit = 30
self.SteerTarget = 20

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Steps.documentation: Steps is the number of stops along a slider's track, from 2 to 255.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Stick.documentation: StickCenter is the base of the thumbstick, from the element's center, as fractions of its width and height from -0.5 to 0.5. In `"Dynamic"` and `"Following"` modes the base moves to where the touch starts.
StickDeadzone is how far the thumb must move, as a fraction of StickRadius, before StickDirection leaves (0, 0).
StickDirection is the direction from the thumbstick's base toward the thumb, X and Y from -1 to 1 with +Y down.

StickMode is how the thumbstick base follows the touch: `"Fixed"` keeps it at StickCenter, `"Dynamic"` moves it to where the touch starts, and `"Following"` drags it along when the thumb goes past StickRadius.
StickRadius is how far, in pixels, the thumb can move from the center of the base.
StickTip is where the thumb is relative to the base, in multiples of StickRadius. It returns to (0, 0) on release.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Stop.documentation: Stop stops the sound and goes back to the start of the clip.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Stop.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: an alarm that rings for 2 seconds.
self:AddComponent("Sound")
self.SoundId = "144115188075855954"
self.Looped = true
self:Play()

task.wait(2)
self:Stop()
print(self.Playing) -- prints false

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.StopA.documentation: StopAnimation stops the clips a script played and any preview, so the walk, idle and jump animations play again. `fade` is the fade-out time in seconds.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.StopA.code_sample:
-- Server script: sit for 3 seconds.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
task.wait()
npc:PlayAnimation("sit")
task.wait(3)
npc:StopAnimation(0.2)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.StopP.documentation: StopPreview closes the animation preview on the character and returns whether one was open.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.StopP.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local rig = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
task.wait()
rig:PreviewAnimation("walk", false)
print(rig:StopPreview()) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.StopT.documentation: StopTimer stops the countdown timer on the instance and sets `TimeLeft` to 0.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Strip.documentation: StripeColor3 is the color of every other line of a list or grid.
StripeTransparency is the transparency of the stripes, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.SunDi.documentation: SunDiskScale is the size of the sun disk of the place's Sun.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Surfa.documentation: SurfaceCanvasSizeX is the width in pixels of the 2D canvas drawn on a face of the parent part.
SurfaceCanvasSizeY is the height in pixels of the 2D canvas drawn on a face of the parent part.
SurfaceFace is the face of the parent part the surface UI draws on: `"Right"`, `"Top"`, `"Back"`, `"Left"`, `"Bottom"` or `"Front"`.
SurfaceLightInfluence is how much scene lighting shades the surface canvas, from 0 (always full brightness) to 255 (lit like the scene).
SurfaceMaxDistance is how far, in world units, the local character can be from the surface and still use its controls; 0 allows any distance.
SurfacePixelsPerUnit is how many canvas pixels cover one world unit of the face. When positive it sets the canvas size; 0 uses SurfaceCanvasSizeX and SurfaceCanvasSizeY.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Suspe.documentation: SuspensionDamping is the damping against suspension speed, as a multiple of the parent part's mass. At 0 the parent part keeps bouncing.
SuspensionDirection is the direction the wheel drops from `SuspensionHardpoint`, in the parent part's frame. A zero vector turns the suspension off.

SuspensionHardpoint is where the raycast suspension of a wheel part mounts on the wheel's parent part, in units in the parent's frame. A ray from this point finds the ground, and the spring pushes the parent upward at this point.
SuspensionMaxLength is the farthest the wheel hangs from `SuspensionHardpoint`, in units. Past it the wheel leaves the ground.
SuspensionMinLength is the shortest the suspension compresses to, in units. The spring pushes no harder past it.
SuspensionRestLength is the distance in units from `SuspensionHardpoint` where the spring pushes with no force.
SuspensionStiffness is the spring force per unit of compression, as a multiple of the parent part's mass.
SuspensionWheelRadius is the radius of the wheel in units for the raycast suspension.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Swatc.documentation: SwatchColor3 is the color of a color swatch button.

SwatchPreview is how a color swatch shows transparency: `"Opaque"` ignores it, `"Checker"` draws the color over a checkerboard, and `"Half"` draws the solid color on the left half and the checkerboard on the right.
SwatchTransparency is the transparency of the color swatch.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Switc.documentation: SwitchWidth is the width in pixels of a toggle switch's track; 0 makes it twice the element's height.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TabCo.documentation: TabColor3 is the color of the buttons of tabs that are not open.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TabTr.documentation: TabTransparency is the transparency of the buttons of tabs that are not open.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TakeD.documentation: TakeDamage lowers the health of a character, or of the character a body part belongs to, and records `attacker`. A negative amount heals.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TakeD.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc:TakeDamage(30)
print(npc.Health) -- prints 70

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Team.documentation: Team is the team number of this player or character, or 0 for none.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Team.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local red = Instance.new("Team")
red.Name = "Red"
red.TeamColor = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Instance)
    player.Team = red.TeamId
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TeamC.documentation: TeamColor is the team color in the player list and chat.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Text.documentation: Text is the text of a label, text box or button. With a `"Fit"` size mode, the element sizes to it.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TextC.documentation: TextColor3 is the color of the text.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TextS.documentation: TextSize is the height of the text in pixels, from 1 to 512.
TextStrokeColor3 is the color of the outline around the text.

TextStrokeScale, from 0 to 0.1, adds `TextStrokeScale * TextSize` pixels to TextStrokeWidth, so the outline keeps its ratio to the text at any size. Larger values make outlines overlap neighboring letters.
TextStrokeTransparency is the transparency of the text outline, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).
TextStrokeWidth is how many pixels, from 0 to 64, the text outline grows outward, clamped to about `TextSize / 6`. With TextStrokeScale also 0, there is no outline.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TextT.documentation: TextTransparency is the transparency of the text, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

TextTruncate is how a line of text that runs past the element's width ends. `"AtEnd"` ends the line at the last letter that fits and draws an ellipsis; `"None"` lets it run past. A text box and wrapped text are not affected.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TextW.documentation: TextWrapped, when true, breaks lines at spaces to fit the element's width. When false, a long line is cut off or runs past the element.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TextX.documentation: TextXAlignment aligns the text horizontally in the element: `"Left"`, `"Center"` or `"Right"`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TextY.documentation: TextYAlignment aligns the text vertically in the element: `"Top"`, `"Center"` or `"Bottom"`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Textu.documentation: Texture is the asset id of the image a decal shows. `"0"` draws nothing. `Color` tints the image and `Transparency` fades it.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Textu.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: put a sign on its top face.
local sign = Instance.new("Decal")
sign.Texture = "123456789" -- the asset id of your image
sign.Side = "Top"
sign.Parent = self

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Throt.documentation:
Throttle is the forward input of the character sitting on this seat, from -1 to 1.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Thumb.documentation: ThumbColor3 is the color of the slider's thumb.
ThumbCornerRadius is the corner radius in pixels, 0 to 1000, of the slider's thumb. 0 draws a round thumb.
ThumbImage is the asset id of the image on the slider's thumb. `"0"` draws a plain thumb in `ThumbColor3`.
ThumbSize is the diameter of a round slider thumb or the side of a square one, in pixels from 0 to 1000.
ThumbTransparency is the transparency of the slider's thumb, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).
