@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TickC.documentation: TickColor3 is the color of the tick marks along the slider's track.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TickL.documentation: TickLength is the length in pixels, 0 to 1000, of the tick marks across the slider's track; 0 draws none.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TickT.documentation: TickTransparency is the transparency of the tick marks, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TileS.documentation: TileSize is the size of one tile of a `"Tile"` image: the scale is a fraction of the element's size and the offset is pixels. A zero side draws one tile across that side.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Tilin.documentation: Tiling scales the U and V texture coordinates by X and Y; Z is ignored. Values above 1 repeat the texture, values between 0 and 1 stretch it, and negative values mirror it. Triplanar and stud materials, and the clothing layer that Color describes, ignore `UvTransform`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TimeL.documentation:
TimeLeft is the number of seconds left on the countdown, or 0 when the timer is not running.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.TimeL.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:AddComponent("Timer")
self.WaitTime = 10
self:AddComponent("TimerRunning")

task.wait(4)
print(math.round(self.TimeLeft)) -- prints 6

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Timeo.documentation:
Timeout fires each time the countdown reaches zero.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Timeo.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: chime 3 times, 1 second apart.
self:AddComponent("Timer")
self.WaitTime = 1

local count = 0
self.Timeout:Connect(function()
    count += 1
    print("chime", count)
    if count == 3 then
        self:RemoveComponent("TimerRunning")
    end
end)

self:AddComponent("TimerRunning")

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Timer.documentation: TimerAutostart starts the timer from `WaitTime` when the instance enters the world, then sets itself back to `false`.
TimerOneShot stops the timer after one countdown. Without it, the timer starts over each time it fires.
TimerPaused pauses the countdown and keeps `TimeLeft`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Title.documentation: TitleHeight is the height in pixels of a window's title bar, which the player drags to move the window.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Toggl.documentation: TogglePrefab is the name of a prefab whose spawned UI root this button shows or hides when clicked. The engine sets the button's `On` while that root is visible.

ToggleTarget is the `UIRoot` that TogglePrefab names, or nil while none exists.

Client only.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Touch.documentation:
TouchEnded fires when a body stops touching this part. The other instance may already be destroyed; check IsAlive before indexing it.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Touch.code_sample:
-- Server script in a pressure plate part.
self.Anchored = true
self.TouchEnded:Connect(function(other: Instance)
    if other:IsAlive() then
        print(other.Name, "stepped off")
    end
end)

local crate = Instance.new("Part")
crate.Name = "Crate"
crate.Position = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
crate.Parent = game.World
task.wait(1)
crate.Position = Vector3.new(20, 3, 0)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Touch.documentation:
Touched fires when a body starts touching this part. For a player, the other instance is a limb such as `Left Leg`, or the character itself when its capsule overlaps the part; `game.Players.FromCharacter` takes either. A tool a character holds fires `Touched` for what it touches, but never for its holder. Reading `Touched`, `TouchEnded` or `Hit` on an instance without a `Shape` or `Collider` raises an error.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Touch.code_sample:
-- Server script in a lava part: destroy whatever lands on it.
self.Anchored = true
self.Touched:Connect(function(other: Instance)
    print(other.Name, "burns")
    other:Destroy()
end)

local crate = Instance.new("Part")
crate.Name = "Crate"
crate.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
crate.Parent = game.World

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Track.documentation: TrackAxis is the way the slider runs: `"Horizontal"` left to right, or `"Vertical"` up and down.
TrackColor3 is the color of the unfilled part of the slider's track.
TrackImage is the asset id of the image on the unfilled part of the slider's track. `"0"` draws a plain track in `TrackColor3`.
TrackThickness is the thickness in pixels, 0 to 1000, of the slider's track.
TrackTransparency is the transparency of the unfilled track, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Trans.documentation: TransformDirection turns a direction in the instance's own frame into a world direction.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Trans.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 90, 0)
local forward = self:TransformDirection(Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
print(math.round(forward.x)) -- prints -1

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Trans.documentation: TransformPoint turns a position in the instance's own frame into a world position.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Trans.code_sample:
-- Server script in a gun part: find the muzzle 2 units in front of it.
self.Position = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
self.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 90, 0)
local muzzle = self:TransformPoint(Vector3.new(0, 0, -2))
print(math.round(muzzle.x)) -- prints -2

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Trans.documentation: Transparency is how see-through the surface is, from 0 (solid) to 1 (invisible). It does not change collisions or raycasts.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Trave.documentation: Travel is how far in units a wheel moves up and down from its `Mount`. 0 is a rigid axle.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Trigg.documentation: Trigger lets parts and characters pass through this part while it still fires `Touched` and `TouchEnded`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Trigg.code_sample:
-- Server script in a checkpoint part that crates fall through.
self.Anchored = true
self.Trigger = true
self.Touched:Connect(function(other: Instance)
    print(other.Name, "passed")
end)

local crate = Instance.new("Part")
crate.Name = "Crate"
crate.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
crate.Parent = game.World

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Twist.documentation: TwistAxis is the axis `TwistMin` and `TwistMax` limit rotation around, in the parent part's frame. The default zero vector means `(0, 1, 0)`.
TwistMax is the upper rotation limit in degrees around `TwistAxis`, from the rest pose.
TwistMin is the lower rotation limit in degrees around `TwistAxis`, from the rest pose.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Type.documentation: Type is the basic shape of a part, used for drawing, raycasts and its default collider: `"Box"`, `"Sphere"`, `"Cylinder"` (along Y), `"Cone"` (pointing +Y) or `"Wedge"` (sloping along -Z), scaled by `Size`. A part with a `Mesh` draws the mesh instead. On an `InputAction`, Type is an Input.ActionType.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Type.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: drop a ball above it.
local ball = Instance.new("Part")
ball.Type = "Sphere"
ball.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
ball.Position = self.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
ball.Parent = game.World

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UIBut.documentation: UIButton is the UI button that presses the binding's `Parent` action when the player presses or taps it; nil binds no button. On a `Direction2D` action, a thumbstick button adds its `StickDirection` with up as +Y.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UICli.documentation: UIClickable, when true, makes the element take pointer clicks and fire click signals. When it is false, clicks pass through to the elements behind.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UIPos.documentation: UIPosition is the old name of a UI element's Position. Reading or writing it warns `Instance.UIPosition is deprecated; use Instance.Position`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UIRoo.documentation: UIRoot, when true, makes the element the top of its own screen layer. An element under `game.Overlay` draws only when it or an ancestor below `game.Overlay` has UIRoot set to true.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UISiz.documentation: UISize is the old name of a UI element's Size. Reading or writing it warns `Instance.UISize is deprecated; use Instance.Size`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UISur.documentation: UISurfaceAlwaysOnTop, when true, draws the surface UI in front of everything in the 3D scene.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UITog.documentation: UIToggleButton, when true, makes the button stay pressed after a click and pop back up on the next click.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Under.documentation: Underlay is the asset id of a second texture drawn under Albedo and over the surface color. It draws only when the instance has its own Color, is a character part with a body color, or has a mesh file that colors the sub-mesh. `"0"` means none.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Unequ.documentation: UnequipTools puts the tool the character holds back in its hotbar slot.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Unequ.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc:EquipTool(Instance.new("Tool"))
npc:UnequipTools()
print(npc:GetTool()) -- prints nil

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Unequ.documentation:
Unequipped fires when a character unequips or drops this tool. On the server it also fires when the holding character dies. The callback receives the player, or nil for a character no player controls.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Unequ.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
local sword = Instance.new("Tool")
sword.Unequipped:Connect(function()
    print("put away")
end)
npc:EquipTool(sword)
npc:UnequipTools() -- prints put away

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Up.documentation: Up is the Input.Key on an `InputBinding` that adds +1 on Y to a `Direction2D` action while held. 0 binds no key. The action adds all its bindings and shortens a sum longer than 1, so W and D together read about (0.707, 0.707).
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Up.code_sample:
-- Client script: read WASD as one direction.
local gameplay = Instance.new("InputContext")
local steer = Instance.new("InputAction")
steer.Type = "Direction2D"
steer.Parent = gameplay
local wasd = Instance.new("InputBinding")
wasd.Up = game.Input.Key.W
wasd.Down = game.Input.Key.S
wasd.Left = game.Input.Key.A
wasd.Right = game.Input.Key.D
wasd.Parent = steer

steer.StateChanged:Connect(function(direction)
    print(direction)
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UpDir.documentation: UpDirection is the direction the character stands along. Floor checks, jumps and the force that keeps it upright follow it.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Upper.documentation: UpperTranslation is the longest `Distance` the rope motor reels out to. The motor stops there.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UseLi.documentation: UseLimits keeps the hinge angle between `LimitsMin` and `LimitsMax`. With both limits at their default of 0, the hinge does not turn.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UseMo.documentation: UseMotor turns the hinge at `MotorTargetVelocity` with up to `MotorForce`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UseMo.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: spin a platform on top of it a quarter turn per second.
self.Anchored = true

local top = Instance.new("Part")
top.Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.5, 6)
top.Position = self.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
top.Parent = game.World
top.HingeAxis = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
top.MotorForce = 10000
top.MotorTargetVelocity = 90
top.UseMotor = true
top.ConnectedBody = self

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.UserI.documentation:
UserId is the account user id of this player, or 0.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Value.documentation: Value is the step the slider's thumb is on, from 0 to `Steps - 1`. Dragging the thumb changes it and fires `Activated`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Vecto.documentation: VectorCount is how many fields a vector input shows: 2 (X, Y) or 3 (X, Y, Z).
VectorMax is the highest value a vector input's fields take, ignored at or below VectorMin.
VectorMin is the lowest value a vector input's fields take, ignored at or above VectorMax.
VectorSpeed is how much a vector input field changes per pixel the pointer drags sideways.
VectorValue is the vector a vector input shows and edits. Dragging or typing in a field changes it and fires `Activated`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Veloc.documentation: Velocity is the linear velocity of the body in units per second, in world space. On a member of a welded assembly, Velocity is the velocity of that member's point.
notes: On an anchored part, Velocity moves the surface while the part stays put, as on a conveyor belt. Parts and characters on it ride along. An `AngVelocity` on the anchored part spins the surface like a turntable.
On an anchored part with a water material, Velocity is the current that floating parts and swimming characters drift with.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Veloc.code_sample:
-- Server script in a jump pad part.
local launch = Vector3.new(0, 60, 0)

self.Touched:Connect(function(hit: Instance)
    local character = hit.Character
    if character then
        character.Velocity = launch
    end
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.ViewS.documentation:
ViewSource is the camera whose view game.World.Screen shows, or nil for none.

Client only.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Visib.documentation: Visible is whether a UI element and everything under it show and take the pointer. On any other instance, Visible is the opposite of RenderDisabled.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Volum.documentation: Volume is how loud the sound plays. 0 is silent and 1 is the recorded loudness.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.WaitF.documentation: WaitForChild returns the direct child with a matching `Name`, and waits for it when it is not there yet. A client script needs it for anything the server creates, which arrives after the script starts.
notes: When the child is missing, the script pauses and checks again once per tick.
A wait without a timeout prints `Infinite yield possible on '<parent>:WaitForChild("<name>")'` once after 5 seconds, then keeps waiting.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.WaitF.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
task.delay(1, function()
    local blade = Instance.new("Part")
    blade.Name = "Blade"
    blade.Parent = self
end)

local blade = self:WaitForChild("Blade", 5) -- pauses about 1 second
print(blade ~= nil) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.WaitT.documentation: WaitTime is how many seconds the timer counts down. Set it before you attach `TimerRunning`; a change takes effect on the next countdown.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.WalkS.documentation: WalkSpeed is how fast the character walks, in units/s.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.Wheel.documentation: WheelRadius is the radius of a tire in units for the tire model. The tire rolls without slip when its spin times WheelRadius equals its ground speed.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.WireC.documentation: WireCurvature is how much graph wires curve, from 0 (straight) to 1.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.ZInde.documentation: ZIndex is which of overlapping siblings draws on top: higher numbers draw in front, and equal numbers draw in tree order, later siblings on top.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.ZeroL.documentation: ZeroLiftDrag is a wing's drag coefficient when it makes no lift.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.attr.documentation:
attr is the map of named values that scripts store on this instance: numbers, booleans, strings of at most 64 bytes, or vectors. Assigning nil removes an attribute. Iterate it with `for ... in part.attr`; `pairs()` fails on it.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Instance.attr.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.attr.Coins = 10
self.attr.Coins += 5
self.attr.Owner = "Igor"
for name, value in self.attr do
    print(name, value)
end
self.attr.Owner = nil -- removes it

@luduvo/client/globaltype/LeaderboardCol.documentation: LeaderboardColumn is one column of the player list. Its Name is the header, and each player's cell shows the attribute named by Stat on that player's `leaderstats`. While no LeaderboardColumn exists, the list shows every `leaderstats` attribute, sorted by name; once one exists, it shows only the LeaderboardColumn columns. See Players for how values show.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/LeaderboardCol.code_sample:
-- Server script: rank players by kills, and show deaths beside them.
local kills = Instance.new("LeaderboardColumn") :: LeaderboardColumn
kills.Name = "Kills"
kills.Order = 1
kills.Sort = "Descending"

local deaths = Instance.new("LeaderboardColumn") :: LeaderboardColumn
deaths.Name = "Deaths"
deaths.Order = 2

@luduvo/client/globaltype/LeaderboardCol.documentation: Hidden hides the column everywhere in the list. A hidden column still ranks players when it sorts.
Order places columns from the lowest Order on the left to the highest on the right. The list has room for four columns; a column without room does not show and warns once in the output.

Sort sets how this column ranks players: `"Descending"` puts the highest value first, `"Ascending"` the lowest, and `"None"` does not rank. Players rank by the first column in Order that sorts; when none sorts, the first shown column ranks them, highest first. The large number in the list header is the viewing player's value in the column that ranks first, unless that column is hidden.
Stat is the name of the `leaderstats` attribute this column shows. When Stat is empty, the column shows the attribute with the column's own name.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/LeaderboardCol.code_sample:
-- Server script: a K/D column that shows the KillDeathRatio attribute.
local ratio = Instance.new("LeaderboardColumn") :: LeaderboardColumn
ratio.Name = "K/D"
ratio.Stat = "KillDeathRatio"

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialAudio.documentation: MaterialAudio configures footstep or impact sounds.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialAudio..documentation: Clips is an array of 1 to 4 audio asset ID strings.
Gain is the volume multiplier, at least 0 (default 1).
PitchSpread is the random playback speed variation around 1, from 0 to 0.9 (default 0).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialEmissi.documentation: MaterialEmission configures glow texture, color, and brightness.
Texture is the emission map asset ID, or `nil`.
Tint is the `{r, g, b}` color multiplier from 0 to 1 (default `{r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}`).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialEntry..documentation: Id is the material asset ID string.
Name is the material name, 1 to 31 bytes.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialPhysic.documentation: MaterialPhysics configures density, friction, and bounce.
Density is mass per unit volume, greater than 0 (default 1). On an anchored `"Water"` part, `Density` sets buoyancy.
Friction is sliding resistance, at least 0 (default 0.5).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialSpec.documentation: MaterialSpec describes a material for `Materials.DefineMaterial` and `Materials.GetMaterial`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialSpec.B.documentation: Blend is `"Alpha"` or `"Additive"` (`game.Enum.MaterialBlend`, default `"Alpha"`). Requires `Shader`; see transparent materials.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialSpec.F.documentation: Faces is `"Front"`, `"Back"`, or `"Both"` (`game.Enum.MaterialFaces`, default `"Front"`). Requires `Shader`; see faces.
Footsteps is the `MaterialAudio` table for footsteps, or `nil`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialSpec.I.documentation: Id is the material asset ID string.
Impacts is the `MaterialAudio` table for impacts, or `nil`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialSpec.M.documentation: Model is `"UV"`, `"Triplanar"`, or `"Stud"` (`game.Enum.SurfaceModel`), defaulting to `"UV"` when `Shader` is set.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialSpec.N.documentation: Name is 1 to 31 bytes, defaulting to the next unused `"Material<n>"`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialSpec.P.documentation: Params maps up to 16 shader field names to numbers, vectors, booleans, or texture asset IDs, or is `nil`. Update values at runtime with `Materials.SetParam`.

Pipeline is `"Opaque"`, `"Cutout"`, `"Transparent"`, `"Water"`, or `"Decal"` (`game.Enum.MaterialPipeline`). `"Water"` and `"Decal"` require `Model` `"UV"`; when `Shader` is set, `Pipeline` defaults to `"Opaque"` and allows `"Opaque"` or `"Transparent"`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialSpec.S.documentation: Shader is a shader file name in `shaders/` without `.slang`, or `nil`; see writing a material shader.
Studs is the `MaterialStuds` table when `Model` is `"Stud"`, or `nil`.
Surface is the `MaterialSurface` table, optional when `Shader` is set.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialSpec.W.documentation: Water is the `MaterialWater` table when `Pipeline` is `"Water"`, or `nil`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialStuds.documentation: MaterialStuds configures top and bottom stud textures for `"Stud"` materials.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialStuds..documentation: ColorBottom is the bottom-face color and alpha-occlusion texture asset ID, or `nil`.
ColorTop is the top-face color and alpha-occlusion texture asset ID, or `nil`.
NormalBottom is the bottom-face normal map asset ID, or `nil`, with the same channels as `NormalTop`.
NormalTop is the top-face normal map asset ID, or `nil`. Red and green point opposite to `MaterialSurface` `Normal`.
StudsPerTile is units per texture repeat, greater than 0 (default 1).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialSurfac.documentation: MaterialSurface configures surface textures and shading multipliers.
AlphaCutoff is the opacity cutoff from 0 to 1 for `"Cutout"` and `"Decal"` surfaces (default 0.5).
BaseColor is the color and alpha texture asset ID, or `nil`. Required for `"Cutout"` and `"Decal"` pipelines.
MetallicMult scales metalness from 0 (non-metal) to 1 (metal), default 1.
Neon is `true` when surface color emits light (default `false`).
Normal is the normal map asset ID (green points up), or `nil`.
NormalStrength is the normal map strength multiplier (default 1).
Orm is the occlusion (red), roughness (green), and metallic (blue) texture asset ID, or `nil`.
RoughnessMult scales roughness from 0 (glossy) to 1 (matte), default 1.
TileSize is the texture repeat size in units, greater than 0 (default 1).
Tint is the `{r, g, b, a}` color and opacity multiplier from 0 to 1 (default `{r = 1, g = 1, b = 1, a = 1}`).
TintVertex, when `true`, tints textured meshes by the part's `Color` (default `false`).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialWater.documentation: MaterialWater configures optics, foam, flow, and waves for `"Water"` materials.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MaterialWater..documentation: Absorption is the `{r, g, b}` light absorption rate per unit of depth (default `{r = 0, g = 0, b = 0}`).
FlowMap is the flow normal map asset ID, or `nil`.
FlowScale sets the UV repeat scale for `FlowMap` and `Foam` (default 1).
FlowSpeed sets the animation speed for `FlowMap` and `Foam` (default 0).
Foam is the foam texture asset ID, or `nil`.
FoamDepth sets the shoreline depth in units where foam appears (default 0).
WaveAmplitude scales wave height (default 0). When `WaveAmplitude` is nonzero, box water parts displace their top face and cast caustics.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MoveIntent.documentation: MoveIntent is the movement and facing table from the deprecated `Instance:GetMoveIntent` method. Read `CharacterMoveIntent` with `World.Query` instead.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MoveIntent.jum.documentation: jump is true when a jump is requested.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MoveIntent.shi.documentation: shiftLock is true when shift lock aligns facing with the camera.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MoveIntent.tar.documentation: targetYaw is the target yaw around world `+Y` in radians (`0` faces `-Z`, positive is counter-clockwise from above).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MoveIntent.x.documentation: x is the target world-X velocity in units/s.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/MoveIntent.z.documentation: z is the target world-Z velocity in units/s.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/NumberRange.documentation: NumberRange is an immutable `[Min, Max]` interval from `NumberRange.new`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/NumberRange.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local lifetime = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
print(lifetime.Max - lifetime.Min) -- prints 3

@luduvo/client/globaltype/NumberRange.Ma.documentation: Max is the upper bound, at least `Min`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/NumberSequence.documentation: NumberSequence is an immutable curve of numbers from time 0 to 1, created with `NumberSequence.new`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/NumberSequence.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local fade = NumberSequence.new(1, 0)
print(#fade.Keypoints, fade.Keypoints[1].Value) -- prints 2 1

@luduvo/client/globaltype/NumberSequence.documentation: Keypoints returns a new array of the 2 to 8 `NumberSequenceKeypoint` values in time order.
__eq returns `true` when both sequences have the same keypoints.
__tostring returns `"NumberSequence(t1 v1 e1, t2 v2 e2, ...)"`.
NumberSequenceKeypoint is one immutable point on a `NumberSequence` from `NumberSequenceKeypoint.new`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/NumberSequence.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local point = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 10, 2)
print(point.Value, point.Envelope) -- prints 10 2

@luduvo/client/globaltype/NumberSequence.documentation: Envelope is the non-negative random spread around `Value` (`0` for none).
Time is the position on the curve (`0` at the start, `1` at the end).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OperatorSpec.documentation: OperatorSpec is passed to plugin:Operator to configure an operator.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OperatorSpec.E.documentation: Execute is called as `Execute(ctx, params)` to apply edits through `ctx.Edit`. Return `true` and an optional Output message to keep the edits, or return `false` (or raise an error) to undo every edit of the run.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OperatorSpec.I.documentation: Icon is a button icon path inside the plugin folder, such as `"icons/hollow.svg"`, or `nil`.
Id is the operator identifier, such as `"build.hollow"`, exposed as the Studio command `plugin.build.hollow`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OperatorSpec.P.documentation: Params lists up to 32 `ParamSpec` entries in order, or is `nil`.
Poll is called as `Poll(ctx)` to test whether the operator can run, or is `nil` when it always can. Return `true` to enable the button, or `false` and an optional tooltip reason to disable it.

Prefab is a `.ldv` UI prefab path (relative to the plugin folder) opened before a button run, or `nil` to run at once. When a descendant's `Name` matches a visible parameter, Studio fills it from the last confirmed run or that parameter's `Default`; Studio runs on `"OK"` or `Enter` and closes on `"Cancel"` or `Escape`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OperatorSpec.T.documentation: Tooltip is the button hover text, or `nil`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OrderedCloudSt.documentation: OrderedCloudStore is a shared leaderboard of integer scores opened with `CloudStore.open_ordered`; see `CloudStore` for request budgets. Keys are integers or strings of 1 to 50 printable characters, and Luau numbers represent integers without rounding in `[-2^53, 2^53]`.
get loads the score saved under `key`. The callback receives `(score, nil)` when found, `(nil, nil)` when missing, or `(nil, "get failed")` on failure.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/OrderedCloudSt.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local wins = game.CloudStore.open_ordered("total_wins")

wins:get(1001, function(score, err)
    if not err then
        print(score or 0)
    end
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OrderedCloudSt.documentation: get_sorted loads up to `limit` (1 to 100) `{ key, value }` entries sorted by score: lowest first when `ascending` is `true`, highest first when `false`. Optional `min_score`, `max_score`, and `after` arguments before `callback` bound the score range or continue after the last entry of the previous page.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/OrderedCloudSt.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local wins = game.CloudStore.open_ordered("total_wins")

-- Load the top 10 scores.
wins:get_sorted(false, 10, nil, nil, nil, function(entries, err)
    if err then
        warn(err)
        return
    end
    for rank, entry in entries do
        print(rank, entry.key, entry.value)
    end
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OrderedCloudSt.documentation: set saves an integer `score` under `key`, replacing any earlier score. The optional callback receives `(true, nil)` when saved, or `(false, "set failed")` on failure.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/OrderedCloudSt.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local wins = game.CloudStore.open_ordered("total_wins")

game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Instance)
    wins:set(player.UserId, 1, function(ok, err)
        if not ok then
            warn(err)
        end
    end)
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OverlayItem.documentation: OverlayItem describes one 3D viewport shape in a tool's `Modal` overlay list (up to 1,024 items), in `Part`'s unscaled local frame.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OverlayItem.Co.documentation: Color is an RGB `vector` from 0 to 1, or `nil` for white `(1, 1, 1)`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OverlayItem.Fi.documentation: Fill draws translucent box faces when `true`, or edges only when `false` or `nil`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OverlayItem.Ma.documentation: Max is the upper box corner.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OverlayItem.Mi.documentation: Min is the lower box corner.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OverlayItem.Pa.documentation: Part is the instance whose position and rotation set the coordinate frame.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/OverlayItem.St.documentation: Step is grid spacing in units, or `nil` or 0 for the border only.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Pair.documentation: Pair is an entity relationship (`"ChildOf"`, `"Tag"`, or `"WornBy"`) built with `World.Pair` and has no fields or methods. Pass it to `World.Query`, `World.Each`, `Query:With`, `Query:Without`, or `Instance` component methods.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ParamSpec.Defa.documentation: Default is the fallback number, boolean, string, or `vector` when a call omits the parameter, or `nil`. `"MoveIncrement"` and `"RotateIncrement"` use Studio's snap steps at call time.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ParamSpec.From.documentation: From is `"Selection"` to fill an omitted `"instance"` or `"instances"` parameter from Studio's selection, or `nil`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ParamSpec.Hidd.documentation: Hidden omits the parameter from an operator prefab's prefilled fields when `true`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ParamSpec.Labe.documentation: Label is the display name, or `nil` to use `Name`.
Labels lists up to 64 choice strings for an `"enum"` parameter.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ParamSpec.Name.documentation: Name is the key in `Execute`'s `params` table and in `Name=value` command arguments.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PartOperationC.documentation: PartOperation is a union, an intersection, or a negative part that `game.Csg` makes. Its parts stay inside it. The server and every client rebuild the combined shape from them, so moving or resizing a part inside rebuilds it. Setting the operation's `Size` stretches the shape without a rebuild.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/PartOperationC.code_sample:
-- Server script in a wall part: cut a doorway and paint the wall white.
self.Anchored = true
self.Size = Vector3.new(12, 8, 1)

local doorway = Instance.new("Part")
doorway.Anchored = true
doorway.Size = Vector3.new(4, 7, 2)
doorway.Position = self.Position

local wall = game.Csg.Subtract(self, { doorway }) :: PartOperation?
if wall then
    print(wall.Type) -- prints Union
    wall.UsePartColor = true
    wall.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PartOperationC.documentation: CollisionFidelity sets how the operation collides. `"Default"` gives an anchored operation its exact shape and an unanchored one a convex hull per separate piece, so the space between the arms of an unanchored U shape is solid. `"Hull"` uses one convex hull around the whole shape, and `"Box"` the bounding box.

Type is `"Union"`, `"Intersect"` or `"Negate"`. A union adds its parts together, an intersection keeps only the volume every part shares, and a negative part cuts its shape out of the operation it is in. `game.Csg` sets it.

Read only at runtime.
UsePartColor draws every face in the operation's own color and material instead of those of the part it came from.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Plugin.documentation: Plugin is the type of the `plugin` global, which registers a Studio plugin's operators, viewport tools, and Plugins tab buttons. Declare each operator before any tool or ribbon group that references its `Id`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Plugin.Operato.documentation: Operator registers an undoable Studio action exposed as `plugin.<Id>`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Plugin.Ribbon.documentation: Ribbon adds a button group of declared operators and tools to Studio's Plugins tab.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Plugin.Tool.documentation: Tool registers an interactive 3D viewport tool whose confirmed gesture runs a declared operator. `"Escape"` is always sent to `Modal` even when `Keys` omits it.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Plugin.Tool.code_sample:
-- Plugin script (plugins/build/init.lua).
plugin:Operator({
    Id = "build.raise",
    Label = "Raise",
    Params = { { Name = "Part", Type = "instance", Hidden = true } },
    Execute = function(ctx: PluginContext, params)
        local edit = ctx.Edit :: PluginEdit
        local part = params.Part :: Instance
        edit:Set(part, "Position", part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
        return true
    end,
})

plugin:Tool({
    Id = "build.pick",
    Label = "Pick",
    Operator = "build.raise",
    Modal = function(ctx: PluginContext, event)
        if event.Kind == "key" and event.Key == "Escape" then
            return "exit"
        end
        local hit = event.Hit
        if event.Kind == "press" and event.Button == 1 and hit then
            return "confirm", nil, nil, { Part = hit.Part }
        end
        return "running", nil, "Click a part to raise it"
    end,
})

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginContext.documentation: PluginContext passes Studio's selection, snap steps, camera state, and (inside `Execute`) `Edit` to `Poll`, `Execute`, and `Modal`. Studio builds a fresh context per call; do not store it across calls.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginContext..documentation: Camera is Studio's edit camera table: `Position` and `Pivot` in world units, `Yaw` and `Pitch` in radians, `Distance` in units, and `Focused` (`true` when right-drag orbits `Pivot`).
Edit is the `PluginEdit` handle inside `Execute`, or `nil` in `Poll` and `Modal`. Changing the place directly outside `ctx.Edit` raises an error.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginContext..code_sample:
-- Plugin script (plugins/build/init.lua).
plugin:Operator({
    Id = "build.paint_red",
    Label = "Paint Red",
    Execute = function(ctx: PluginContext)
        local edit = ctx.Edit :: PluginEdit
        for _, part in ctx.Selection do
            edit:Set(part, "Color", Color3.new(1, 0, 0))
        end
        return true
    end,
})

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginContext..documentation: MoveIncrement is Studio's move snap step in units.
RotateIncrement is Studio's rotate snap step in degrees.
Selection is the array of instances selected in Studio at call time.
Snap takes `(value, increment, from, to)` and clamps `value` between `from` and `to`, rounding to steps of `increment` from `math.min(from, to)` when `increment > 0`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginContext..code_sample:
-- Plugin script (plugins/build/init.lua).
plugin:Operator({
    Id = "build.snap_height",
    Label = "Snap Height",
    Execute = function(ctx: PluginContext)
        local edit = ctx.Edit :: PluginEdit
        for _, part in ctx.Selection do
            local y = ctx.Snap(part.Position.Y, ctx.MoveIncrement, 0, 100)
            edit:Set(part, "Position", Vector3.new(part.Position.X, y, part.Position.Z))
        end
        return true
    end,
})

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.documentation: PluginEdit modifies the edit place inside an operator's `Execute` via `ctx.Edit`. World edits form one undo step and roll back if `Execute` returns `false` or errors; `Select` and `SetCamera` apply after `Execute` succeeds, outside the undo step.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Cop.documentation: Copy duplicates `inst` under the same parent without children, scripts, decals, attachments, or welds, and returns the copy.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Cop.code_sample:
-- Plugin script (plugins/build/init.lua).
plugin:Operator({
    Id = "build.stack",
    Label = "Stack Copy",
    Execute = function(ctx: PluginContext)
        local edit = ctx.Edit :: PluginEdit
        local part = ctx.Selection[1]
        if part then
            edit:Copy(part, { Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y, 0) })
        end
        return true
    end,
})

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Cre.documentation: Create takes `(class, props, parent)`, adds a new instance of `class` under `parent` (or the place root when `nil`), and returns it. In `props`, `Frame` copies the world pose of an instance.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Des.documentation: Destroy removes `inst` and its descendants from the place.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Des.code_sample:
-- Plugin script (plugins/build/init.lua).
plugin:Operator({
    Id = "build.delete_selected",
    Label = "Delete Selected",
    Execute = function(ctx: PluginContext)
        local edit = ctx.Edit :: PluginEdit
        for _, inst in ctx.Selection do
            edit:Destroy(inst)
        end
        return true
    end,
})

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Res.documentation: Reshape sets `part`'s size and world center while keeping children and welded parts at their world poses.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Res.code_sample:
-- Plugin script (plugins/build/init.lua).
plugin:Operator({
    Id = "build.slab",
    Label = "Make Slab",
    Execute = function(ctx: PluginContext)
        local edit = ctx.Edit :: PluginEdit
        for _, part in ctx.Selection do
            edit:Reshape(part, Vector3.new(part.Size.X, 1, part.Size.Z), part.Position)
        end
        return true
    end,
})

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Sel.documentation: Select sets Studio's selection (up to 4,096 instances) when `Execute` succeeds.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Sel.code_sample:
-- Plugin script (plugins/build/init.lua).
plugin:Operator({
    Id = "build.create_and_select",
    Label = "New Block",
    Execute = function(ctx: PluginContext)
        local edit = ctx.Edit :: PluginEdit
        local block = edit:Create("Part", { Position = ctx.Camera.Pivot })
        edit:Select({ block })
        return true
    end,
})

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Set.documentation: Set assigns `inst[name] = value`, moving descendants and welded parts on pose changes the same way Studio does.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Set.code_sample:
-- Plugin script (plugins/build/init.lua).
plugin:Operator({
    Id = "build.anchor",
    Label = "Anchor Selected",
    Execute = function(ctx: PluginContext)
        local edit = ctx.Edit :: PluginEdit
        for _, part in ctx.Selection do
            edit:Set(part, "Anchored", true)
        end
        return true
    end,
})

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Set.documentation: SetCamera takes `(position, yaw, pitch, distance)` (with `yaw` and `pitch` in radians) and moves Studio's edit camera when `Execute` succeeds. Passing `distance` focuses an orbit pivot that many units ahead of `position`.
SetParent moves `inst` under `parent` (or the place root when `nil`) while preserving its world transform.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEdit.Set.code_sample:
-- Plugin script (plugins/build/init.lua).
plugin:Operator({
    Id = "build.group",
    Label = "Group Selection",
    Execute = function(ctx: PluginContext)
        local edit = ctx.Edit :: PluginEdit
        local folder = edit:Create("Folder", { Name = "Group" })
        for _, inst in ctx.Selection do
            edit:SetParent(inst, folder)
        end
        return true
    end,
})

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEvent.documentation: PluginEvent describes one viewport input event passed to `ToolSpec.Modal`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEvent.Al.documentation: Alt is `true` while Alt is held.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEvent.Bu.documentation: Button is `1` for left button (`"press"`, `"release"`, and `"move"` while held), `2` on `"press"` and `"release"` for a stationary right click, or `0` otherwise.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEvent.Ct.documentation: Ctrl is `true` while Ctrl is held.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEvent.De.documentation: DeltaX is horizontal cursor motion in pixels since the last press or release.
DeltaY is vertical cursor motion in pixels since the last press or release.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEvent.Hi.documentation: Hit is the `PluginHit` for the nearest unlocked part within 1,000 units, or `nil`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEvent.Ke.documentation: Key is `"Escape"`, `"Return"`, `"Backspace"`, `"Tab"`, `"Space"`, `"Delete"`, `"A"` to `"Z"`, or `"0"` to `"9"` on `"key"`, or `nil` otherwise.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEvent.Ra.documentation: RayDirection is the world-space unit ray direction through the cursor.
RayOrigin is the world-space camera ray origin through the cursor.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEvent.Sh.documentation: Shift is `true` while Shift is held.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginEvent.Wh.documentation: WheelSteps is the signed wheel delta (`-127` to `127`) on `"wheel"`, or `0` otherwise.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginHit.documentation: PluginHit describes where a PluginEvent cursor ray hits an unlocked part within 1000 units. Local coordinates are in units from the part's center along its unscaled axes.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginHit.Face.documentation: Face is the hit side: `"Right"`, `"Left"`, `"Top"`, `"Bottom"`, `"Back"`, or `"Front"`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginHit.Loca.documentation: LocalNormal is the outward face normal in `Part`'s frame.
LocalPosition is the hit point in `Part`'s frame.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginHit.Norm.documentation: Normal is the outward face normal in world space.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/PluginHit.Posi.documentation: Position is the hit point in world space.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ProductReceipt.documentation: ProductReceipt describes a consumable purchase passed to `Marketplace.ProcessReceipt`.
PlayerId is the buyer's user ID; pass it to `Players.Get` to find the player.
Price is the price paid in Lunes (`0` in Studio Play).
ProductId is the bought developer product ID.
PurchaseId is the unique purchase identifier string.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ProductType.documentation: ProductType is a token from `Marketplace.ProductType` passed to `Marketplace.PromptProductPurchase`: `Consumable` (repeatable receipt), `Durable` (permanent unlock), or `Subscription` (recurring access).
@luduvo/client/globaltype/ProductType.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local VIP_PASS = 9012

game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Instance)
    if not game.Marketplace.OwnsProduct(player, VIP_PASS) then
        game.Marketplace.PromptProductPurchase(
            player,
            VIP_PASS,
            game.Marketplace.ProductType.Durable
        )
    end
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Query.documentation: Query matches entities by component or relationship and exposes their values as `QueryColumn` handles. Create one with `World.Query`, then call `Refresh` or pass it to `World.System`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Query.Entity.documentation: Entity is the column of matched `Instance` handles from `1` to `count`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Query.Instance.documentation: Instance is the column of matched `Instance` handles from `1` to `count`, or `nil` where an entity was destroyed after `Refresh`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Query.Refresh.documentation: Refresh compiles the query on first call, snapshots matching entities into its columns, and returns `count`.
notes: Calling `With` or `Without` after the first `Refresh` raises an error.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Query.Refresh.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:AddComponent(game.World.Pair("Tag", "Hazard"))

local hazards = game.World.Query("Position", game.World.Pair("Tag", "Hazard"))
local count = hazards:Refresh()
print(count, hazards.Instance[1] == self) -- prints 1   true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Query.With.documentation: With adds a required component or `Pair` before the first `Refresh` and returns the query (up to 8 terms total).
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Query.With.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:AddComponent("Timer")

local timed = game.World.Query("Position"):With("Timer")
print(timed:Refresh()) -- prints 1

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Query.Without.documentation: Without excludes entities with a component or `Pair` before the first `Refresh` and returns the query.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Query.Without.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Anchored = false

local moving = game.World.Query("Position"):Without("Anchored")
print(moving:Refresh() >= 1) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Query.count.documentation: count is the number of entities matched by the last `Refresh`, or 0 before the first refresh.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/QueryColumn.documentation: QueryColumn reads and writes one value per entity matched by a `Query`, indexed from `1` to `Query.count`. Read and write single-field components (`Position`, `Velocity`, `Scale`) directly at `column[i]`; for multi-field components (`Timer`, `Light`, `UIRect`), index the field name first (`query.Timer.WaitTime[i]`).
@luduvo/client/globaltype/QueryColumn.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Position = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
self:AddComponent("Timer")
self.WaitTime = 2

local timed = game.World.Query("Position", "Timer")
for i = 1, timed:Refresh() do
    timed.Position[i] = timed.Position[i] + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
    timed.Timer.WaitTime[i] = 5
end
print(math.round(self.Position.Y), self.WaitTime) -- prints 10  5

@luduvo/client/globaltype/QueryParams.documentation: QueryParams filters colliders tested by `Physics.Raycast`, `Physics.OverlapSphere`, `Physics.OverlapBox`, and `Physics.Shapecast`. Each instance in `ExcludeInstances` or `IncludeInstances` matches itself and its descendants; if an instance matches both, `ExcludeInstances` wins.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/QueryParams.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Name = "Crate"
self.Position = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
task.wait()

local origin = Vector3.new(0, 5, 10)
local aim = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
local hit = game.Physics.Raycast(origin, aim, 20, { IncludeInstances = { self } })
local skipped = game.Physics.Raycast(origin, aim, 20, { ExcludeInstances = { self } })
print(hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance.Name, skipped) -- prints Crate  nil

@luduvo/client/globaltype/QueryParams.At.documentation: AtTick rewinds character hitboxes on a server `Raycast` to a past `ServerTick` (up to 64 ticks back). Other colliders and other query functions ignore `AtTick`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/QueryParams.Co.documentation: CollisionGroup names the registered collision group for the query, which hits only colliders whose group collides with that group, or `nil` to test every group.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/QueryParams.Ex.documentation: ExcludeInstances lists up to 128 instances (and their descendants) to skip.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/QueryParams.In.documentation: IncludeInstances restricts the query to up to 128 instances and their descendants; `{}` hits nothing.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/RaycastResult..documentation: Distance is the distance in units from the ray origin to `Position`.
Entity is the hit `Instance`, or `nil` if destroyed.
Instance is the hit `Instance`, or `nil` if destroyed.
Normal is the outward unit normal at `Position`.
Position is the hit point in world units.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Rect.documentation: Rect is an immutable 2D rectangle `(minX, minY, maxX, maxY)` in pixels, created with `Rect.new`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Rect.__eq.documentation: __eq returns true when all four coordinates match.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/RibbonSpec.documentation: RibbonSpec configures a button group passed to plugin:Ribbon.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/RibbonSpec.Gro.documentation: Group is the group title on the Plugins tab.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/RibbonSpec.Ite.documentation: Items lists up to 64 operator and tool ids in button order.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ScriptCost.documentation: ScriptCost reports per-script callback timings from `Profiler.Scripts`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ScriptCost.avg.documentation: avg is the smoothed per-frame run time in milliseconds across `Update`, `PhysicsUpdate`, and `World.System`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ScriptCost.cal.documentation: calls is the number of `Update`, `PhysicsUpdate`, and `World.System` runs so far in the current frame.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ScriptCost.ent.documentation: entity is the numeric ID of the script's instance (use `path` to identify the script).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ScriptCost.pat.documentation: path is the project script path without a leading `@`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ShapecastHit.documentation: ShapecastHit describes one contact along a sweep from `Physics.Shapecast`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ShapecastHit.F.documentation: Fraction is the sweep progress from `from` (`0`) to `to` (`1`) at contact.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ShapecastHit.N.documentation: Normal is the outward unit normal at `Point`, or `(0, 0, 0)` when shapes start deeply overlapping.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ShapecastHit.P.documentation: Point is the world-space contact point on the hit shape in units.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Signal.documentation: Signal runs functions when something happens in the game. Built-in signals include instance properties such as `Touched`; `Instance:GetSignal` returns a named signal of your own.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Signal.Connect.documentation: Connect runs a function every time the signal emits, until it is disconnected or the instance is destroyed. Each call runs on its own thread, so it may call `task.wait`, and an error in one function does not stop the others.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Signal.Connect.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local scored = self:GetSignal("Scored")

scored:Connect(function(points: number, by: string)
    print(by .. " scored " .. points)
end)

scored:Emit(3, "Ana") -- prints Ana scored 3

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Signal.Disconn.documentation: Disconnect stops a function passed to `Connect` from running. Pass the same function value.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Signal.Disconn.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local alarm = self:GetSignal("Alarm")

local function onAlarm()
    print("alarm")
    alarm:Disconnect(onAlarm)
end

alarm:Connect(onAlarm)
alarm:Connect(function()
    print("still on")
end)

alarm:Emit() -- prints alarm, then still on
alarm:Emit() -- prints still on

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Signal.Emit.documentation: Emit runs every connected function with the given values before it returns. Values cannot be or contain functions or threads, and a table may have at most 16 levels and fewer than 4096 entries.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Signal.Emit.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local wave = self:GetSignal("WaveStarted")

wave:Connect(function(number: number)
    print("wave " .. number)
end)

wave:Emit(1) -- prints wave 1

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Signal.Once.documentation: Once runs a function the next time the signal emits, then disconnects it.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Signal.Once.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local opened = self:GetSignal("Opened")

opened:Once(function()
    print("first time")
end)
opened:Connect(function()
    print("opened")
end)

opened:Emit() -- prints first time, then opened
opened:Emit() -- prints opened

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Signal.Wait.documentation: Wait pauses the script until the signal next emits, then returns the emitted values. It cannot pause `Update` or another callback that must return at once; call it from the top of the script or from `task.spawn`. If the instance is destroyed first, Wait never returns.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Signal.Wait.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local ready = self:GetSignal("Ready")

task.delay(1, function()
    ready:Emit("go")
end)

print(ready:Wait()) -- prints go after one second

@luduvo/client/globaltype/SignalConnecti.documentation: SignalConnection is a subscription from `Signal:Connect` or `Signal:Once`.
Connected is `true` while subscribed, and `false` after `Disconnect`, after a `Once` callback runs, when the script stops, or when the signal's `Instance` is destroyed or `Tween` ends.
Disconnect unsubscribes the callback and sets `Connected` to `false`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/SignalConnecti.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local ping = self:GetSignal("Ping")
local conn: SignalConnection
conn = ping:Connect(function()
    conn:Disconnect()
    print("once") -- prints once
end)
ping:Emit()
task.wait()
print(conn.Connected) -- prints false

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Store.documentation: Store reads and writes per-key tables in a local server save file opened with `Store.open`; see `Store` for file paths. Keys are integers from `0` to `2^53` or decimal digit strings, up to 4,096 unique keys per store.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Store.get.documentation: get reads `key` from memory and returns a copy of its stored table, or `nil` when `key` has no entry.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Store.get.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local saves = game.Store.open("player_gold")
saves:put(1001, { gold = 50 })

local data = saves:get(1001)
print(data and data.gold) -- prints 50

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Store.put.documentation: put writes table `value` under `key` and flushes it to disk before returning. Tables hold numbers, booleans, strings, `Vector3`s, and nested tables (up to 8 levels and 65,536 encoded bytes).
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Store.put.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local saves = game.Store.open("player_gold")
saves:put(1001, { gold = 120, home = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0) })
local saved = saves:get(1001)
print(saved and saved.gold) -- prints 120

@luduvo/client/globaltype/SubscriptionSt.documentation: SubscriptionStatus describes a player's subscription from `Marketplace.GetSubscriptionStatus`.
Active is `true` while the player has an active subscription to the product.
CancelAtPeriodEnd is `true` when `Active` is `true` and renewal was canceled.
CurrentPeriodEnd is the UTC Unix timestamp in seconds when the paid period ends, or `nil` when `Active` is `false`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/SwingTwistJoin.documentation: SwingTwistJointDesc configures a swing-twist joint for the deprecated `Instance:SetSwingTwistJoint` method. Set the `SwingTwistJoint` properties on `Instance` directly instead.
Anchor is the joint pivot in the parent part's frame, in units.
Friction is the optional opposing torque in Newton-meters, or `nil` for none.
NormalCone is a swing half-angle limit in degrees (`0` to `180`); the active cone uses `math.max(PlaneCone, NormalCone)`.
PlaneAxis is the swing reference axis perpendicular to `TwistAxis` (`(0, 0, 0)` defaults to `(1, 0, 0)`).
PlaneCone is a swing half-angle limit in degrees (`0` to `180`); the active cone uses `math.max(PlaneCone, NormalCone)`.
RestAxis is the optional child resting direction in the parent part's frame, or `nil` to match `TwistAxis`.
TwistAxis is the twist axis in the parent part's frame (`(0, 0, 0)` defaults to `(0, 1, 0)`).
TwistMax is the upper twist limit around `TwistAxis` in degrees (`-180` to `180`).
TwistMin is the lower twist limit around `TwistAxis` in degrees (`-180` to `180`).
SwingTwistJointInfo holds the joint settings returned by the deprecated `Instance:GetSwingTwistJoint` method. Read the `SwingTwistJoint` properties on `Instance` directly instead.
Anchor is the joint pivot in the parent part's frame, in units.
Friction is the opposing torque in Newton-meters.
NormalCone is a swing half-angle limit in degrees (`0` to `180`); the active cone uses `math.max(PlaneCone, NormalCone)`.
PlaneAxis is the swing reference axis in the parent part's frame.
PlaneCone is a swing half-angle limit in degrees (`0` to `180`); the active cone uses `math.max(PlaneCone, NormalCone)`.
RestAxis is the child's resting direction in the parent part's frame, or `(0, 0, 0)` when aligned with `TwistAxis`.
TwistAxis is the twist axis in the parent part's frame.
TwistMax is the upper twist limit around `TwistAxis` in degrees (`-180` to `180`).
TwistMin is the lower twist limit around `TwistAxis` in degrees (`-180` to `180`).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ToolSpec.documentation: ToolSpec configures a viewport tool passed to plugin:Tool.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ToolSpec.Icon.documentation: Icon is a button icon path inside the plugin folder, or `nil`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ToolSpec.Id.documentation: Id is the tool identifier referenced in `RibbonSpec.Items`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ToolSpec.Keys.documentation: Keys lists up to 64 key names (`"Escape"`, `"Return"`, `"Backspace"`, `"Tab"`, `"Space"`, `"Delete"`, `"A"` to `"Z"`, `"0"` to `"9"`) sent to `Modal` instead of viewport shortcuts; `"Escape"` is always included.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ToolSpec.Modal.documentation: Modal handles `PluginEvent`s as `Modal(ctx, event)` while the tool is active. When the tool activates, Studio calls `Modal` once with `"Escape"` so the tool can reset its Lua state and ignores that call's return values.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ToolSpec.Opera.documentation: Operator is the `Id` of the declared operator run on `"confirm"`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/ToolSpec.Toolt.documentation: Tooltip is the button hover text, or `nil`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/TouchEvent.documentation: TouchEvent records a contact change from `Physics.DrainTouchEvents`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/TouchEvent.beg.documentation: began is `true` on contact start and `false` on separation.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.documentation: Tween controls a running property animation from `Tween.TweenProperty`; see `Tween` for tweenable types and frame timing.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.Finished.documentation: Finished fires once with no arguments when the tween reaches its final value, is overridden on the same property, or ends because its `Instance` was destroyed or lost the tweened component. `Kill` does not fire `Finished`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.Finished.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local tween = game.Tween.TweenProperty(self, "Transparency", 1, 0.2)
tween.Finished:Connect(function()
    print("faded") -- prints faded
    self:Destroy()
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.IsRunnin.documentation: IsRunning returns `true` while advancing or waiting out a delay, and `false` when paused or ended.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.IsRunnin.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local tween = game.Tween.TweenProperty(self, "Transparency", 1, 0.2)
print(tween:IsRunning()) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.IsValid.documentation: IsValid returns `true` until the tween reaches its final value, is overridden, is killed, or ends because its `Instance` was destroyed or lost the tweened component.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.IsValid.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local tween = game.Tween.TweenProperty(self, "Transparency", 1, 0.2)
print(tween:IsValid()) -- prints true
task.wait(0.3)
print(tween:IsValid()) -- prints false

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.Kill.documentation: Kill stops the tween at its current value without firing `Finished`, leaving threads in `Finished:Wait()` suspended.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.Kill.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local tween = game.Tween.TweenProperty(self, "Transparency", 1, 1)
task.wait(0.2)
tween:Kill()
print(tween:IsValid()) -- prints false

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.Pause.documentation: Pause freezes the tween at its current elapsed time and value.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.Pause.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local tween = game.Tween.TweenProperty(self, "Transparency", 1, 0.4)
tween:Pause()
print(tween:IsRunning()) -- prints false

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.Play.documentation: Play resumes a paused tween from where it stopped.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.Play.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local tween = game.Tween.TweenProperty(self, "Transparency", 1, 0.4)
tween:Pause()
tween:Play()
print(tween:IsRunning()) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.SetBehav.documentation: SetBehavior sets `"Normal"` (default) or `"AllowDiscrete"` (`game.Enum.TweenBehavior`) and returns the tween. `"AllowDiscrete"` keeps a UI element with `Visible = false` drawn (without receiving input) until the tween ends or pauses.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.SetBehav.code_sample:
-- Client script in a part.
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.UIRect.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 80)
frame.Visible = false

local tween = game.Tween.TweenProperty(frame, "Position", UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), 0.2)
    :SetBehavior("AllowDiscrete")
print(tween:IsRunning()) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.SetDelay.documentation: SetDelay waits `seconds` before reading the start value and advancing, and returns the tween. Once the tween starts, `SetDelay` does nothing.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.SetDelay.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
game.Tween.TweenProperty(self, "Transparency", 1, 0.2):SetDelay(0.2)
task.wait(0.1)
print(self.Transparency) -- prints 0
task.wait(0.4)
print(self.Transparency) -- prints 1

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.SetEase.documentation: SetEase sets which end eases (`"In"`, `"Out"`, `"InOut"`, or `"OutIn"` from `game.Enum.TweenEase`, default `"InOut"`) and returns the tween.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.SetEase.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Anchored = true
self.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)

game.Tween.TweenProperty(self, "Position", Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), 0.5)
    :SetTrans("Bounce")
    :SetEase("Out")
task.wait(0.6)
print(math.round(self.Position.Y)) -- prints 2

@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.SetTrans.documentation: SetTrans sets the curve (`game.Enum.TweenTransition` or a name such as `"Sine"`, `"Quad"`, `"Cubic"`, `"Bounce"`, or `"Spring"`, default `"Linear"`) and returns the tween.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/Tween.SetTrans.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Anchored = true
self.Position = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)

game.Tween.TweenProperty(self, "Position", Vector3.new(0, 12, 0), 0.5)
    :SetTrans("Sine")
task.wait(0.6)
print(math.round(self.Position.Y)) -- prints 12

@luduvo/client/globaltype/UDim.documentation: UDim is an immutable single-axis UI coordinate of parent-relative `Scale` plus pixel `Offset` from `UDim.new`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/UDim.code_sample:
-- Client script in a part.
local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
bar.UIRect.Size = UDim2.new(0.75, -8, 0, 12)
local x = bar.UIRect.Size.X
print(x.Scale, x.Offset) -- prints 0.75 -8

@luduvo/client/globaltype/UDim.Offset.documentation: Offset is the pixel offset added after `Scale`.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/UDim.Scale.documentation: Scale is the fraction of the parent size on this axis (`1` is 100%).

@luduvo/client/globaltype/UDim2.documentation: UDim2 is an immutable 2D UI coordinate of `X` and `Y` `UDim` axes, created with `UDim2.new`, `UDim2.fromScale`, or `UDim2.fromOffset`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/UDim2.code_sample:
-- Client script in a part.
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.UIRect.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0, 24)
print(panel.UIRect.Position.X.Scale, panel.UIRect.Position.Y.Offset) -- prints 0.5  24

@luduvo/client/globaltype/UDim2.Lerp.code_sample:
-- Client script in a part.
local closed = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
local open = UDim2.new(1, -240, 0, 0)
print(closed:Lerp(open, 0.5).X.Offset) -- prints -120

@luduvo/client/globaltype/UDim2.__add.code_sample:
-- Client script in a part.
local pos = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 20) + UDim2.fromOffset(5, -4)
print(pos) -- prints UDim2(0, 15, 0, 16)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/UDim2.__eq.documentation: __eq returns `true` when all four numbers match.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/UDim2.__unm.documentation: __unm negates both scales and both offsets.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.documentation: World is the top of the place's tree of parts and entities. It also runs queries over scene entities and schedules per-frame systems. The server and each client have their own world, and a call acts on the world of the side that makes it.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Camera.documentation:
Camera is the Camera the root Screen views through. Only the client makes it, so it is nil in a server script. A part parented below the Camera keeps its `LocalPosition` on screen, as a viewmodel needs.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Camera.code_sample:
-- Client script: zoom in and attach a viewmodel.
local cam = game.World.Camera
if cam then
    cam.CameraLens.fovY = math.rad(30)
    local vm = Instance.new("Part")
    vm.Anchored = true
    vm.Collider = "None"
    vm.Parent = cam
    vm.LocalPosition = Vector3.new(1, -1, -3)
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.DumpAttr.documentation: DumpAttributes prints every attribute name with its id to the engine log. With an entity, it also prints that entity's attributes with their values.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.DumpAttr.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.attr.Locked = true
game.World:DumpAttributes(self)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Each.documentation: Each visits every scene entity that has a component or relationship pair. Every loop over the result takes a fresh snapshot, so a script can keep the result and loop it again later.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Each.code_sample:
-- Server script.
for part in game.World:Each("Anchored") do
    part.Transparency = 0.5
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.FindFirs.documentation: FindFirstChild returns the first entity at the top of the place with the given name, or nil. With `recursive` true it also searches every level below.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.FindFirs.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local part = Instance.new("Part")
part.Name = "FinishLine"
part.Parent = game.World
print(game.World:FindFirstChild("FinishLine") == part) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.GetChild.documentation: GetChildren returns every entity at the top of the place.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.GetChild.code_sample:
-- Server script.
for _, entity in game.World:GetChildren() do
    print(entity.Name)
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.GetCompo.documentation: GetComponentAddedSignal returns a signal that fires with each entity that gains the component. It does not fire for entities that already have it, so pair it with `World.Each`.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.GetCompo.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
game.World:GetComponentAddedSignal("Admin"):Connect(function(entity: Instance)
    print("admin", entity.Name)
end)
self:AddComponent("Admin")

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.GetCompo.documentation: GetComponentRemovedSignal returns a signal that fires with each entity that loses the component or is destroyed while it has it. A destroyed entity still works as a table key, so a script can clean up its own data.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.GetCompo.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local admins: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
game.World:GetComponentAddedSignal("Admin"):Connect(function(entity: Instance)
    admins[entity] = true
end)
game.World:GetComponentRemovedSignal("Admin"):Connect(function(entity: Instance)
    admins[entity] = nil
    print("admin removed")
end)
self:AddComponent("Admin")
task.wait()
self:RemoveComponent("Admin")

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.GetDesce.documentation: GetDescendants returns every entity in the place, the top level first.
notes: `GetDescendants` builds the whole array on each call, so call it while the script loads, not every tick.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.GetDesce.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local coins = 0
for _, entity in game.World:GetDescendants() do
    if entity.Name == "Coin" then
        coins += 1
    end
end
print(coins)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.HasCompo.documentation: HasComponent returns false, because the World has no components.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.HasCompo.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
print(game.World:HasComponent("Anchored")) -- prints false

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.IsAlive.documentation: IsAlive returns true, because the World lasts as long as the place.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.IsDescen.documentation: IsDescendantOf returns false, because nothing is above the World.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.IsDescen.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
print(self:IsDescendantOf(game.World)) -- prints true
print(game.World:IsDescendantOf(self)) -- prints false

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Name.documentation:
Name is the name of the World, always `World`.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Pair.documentation: Pair makes a relationship pair for `World.Query`, `World.Each`, `World.Spawn`, `Instance:AddComponent` and `Instance:HasComponent`. The relation is `"ChildOf"`, `"Tag"` or `"WornBy"`, and the target `"*"` matches any target.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Pair.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:AddComponent(game.World:Pair("Tag", "Projectile"))
print(self:HasComponent(game.World:Pair("Tag", "Projectile"))) -- prints true

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Parent.documentation:
Parent is always nil, because the World is the top of the place.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Query.documentation: Query builds a cached query over scene entities that have every given component and pair. `Refresh` fills its columns; QueryColumn lists them.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Query.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:AddComponent(game.World:Pair("Tag", "Projectile"))
local bullets = game.World:Query("Position", game.World:Pair("Tag", "Projectile"))
bullets:Refresh()
for i = 1, bullets.count do
    bullets.Position[i] += Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Screen.documentation:
Screen is the root Screen entity. Only the client makes it, so it is nil in a server script. UI parented below it draws on the player's screen, and its `AbsoluteSize` is the viewport size in UI points.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.ScreenTo.documentation:
ScreenToRay returns the origin and unit direction of the ray from the camera through a screen position in UI points.

Client only.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.ScreenTo.code_sample:
-- Client script: print what the mouse clicks.
function Update(_dt: number)
    if game.Input.ButtonPressed(game.Input.Button.Left) then
        local origin, dir = game.World.ScreenToRay(game.Input.MousePosition)
        local hit = game.Physics.Raycast(origin, dir, 200)
        if hit and hit.Instance then
            print("Clicked", hit.Instance.Name)
        end
    end
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Spawn.documentation: Spawn creates an entity named `Instance` at the top of the place with the given components and tag pairs.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.Spawn.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local target = game.World:Spawn("Shape", "Anchored", game.World:Pair("Tag", "Target"))
target.Position = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
print(target.Name) -- prints Instance

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.System.documentation: System registers a callback that runs over a query every tick of its phase. The engine refreshes the query before each run. `phase` defaults to `"Default"`, and `after` names a system in the same phase that runs first.
notes: 5 consecutive runs over the instruction or memory budget stop the script's systems.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.System.code_sample:
-- Server script: move every projectile forward.
local bullets = game.World:Query("Position", game.World:Pair("Tag", "Projectile"))
game.World:System("MoveBullets", bullets, function(q: Query, dt: number)
    for i = 1, q.count do
        q.Position[i] += Vector3.new(0, 0, -10 * dt)
    end
end)

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.WaitForC.documentation: WaitForChild returns the entity at the top of the place with the given name, and waits for it when it is not there yet. It returns nil when `timeout` seconds pass first.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.WaitForC.code_sample:
-- Client script: wait up to 10 seconds for the server's Arena.
local arena = game.World:WaitForChild("Arena", 10)
if arena then
    print(arena.Name)
end

@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.WorldToS.documentation:
WorldToScreen projects a world position onto the screen. It returns `(x, y, depth)`, with `x` and `y` in UI points from the top-left, and whether the point is inside the view.

Client only.
@luduvo/client/globaltype/World.WorldToS.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screenPos, onScreen = game.World.WorldToScreen(Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
print(onScreen, screenPos.x, screenPos.y)

@luduvo/server/global/Color3.documentation: Color3 creates colors. A color is a Luau `vector` whose `R`, `G` and `B` run from 0 to 1; lights and glowing surfaces take values above 1 to shine brighter.

@luduvo/server/global/Color3.fromHSV.documentation: `Color3.fromHSV` creates a color from hue, saturation and value, each from 0 to 1. Hue goes around the color wheel from red (0) through green (0.33) and blue (0.67), and wraps past 1.
@luduvo/server/global/Color3.fromHSV.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: cycle through the rainbow every 5 seconds.
local hue = 0

function Update(dt: number)
    hue = (hue + dt / 5) % 1
    self.Color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
end

@luduvo/server/global/Color3.fromHex.documentation: `Color3.fromHex` creates a color from a six-digit hex code, with or without a leading `#`. The short form `"#F80"` is an error.
@luduvo/server/global/Color3.fromHex.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Color = Color3.fromHex("#FF8800")

@luduvo/server/global/Color3.fromRGB.documentation: `Color3.fromRGB` creates a color from red, green and blue from 0 to 255, the scale of color pickers.
@luduvo/server/global/Color3.fromRGB.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
print(Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)) -- prints 1, 0, 0

@luduvo/server/global/Color3.new.documentation: `Color3.new` creates a color from red, green and blue, each from 0 to 1.
@luduvo/server/global/Color3.new.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Color = Color3.new(1, 0.5, 0)
print(self.Color) -- prints 1, 0.5, 0

@luduvo/server/global/ColorSequence.documentation: ColorSequence creates a color curve over time from 0 to 1, such as the color of a particle over its life. A sequence has 2 to 8 keypoints, and each channel changes in a straight line between them. To read the keypoints, see `ColorSequence`.

@luduvo/server/global/ColorSequence.new.documentation: `ColorSequence.new` creates a sequence of one color, a blend from `c0` to `c1`, or a sequence from a list of `ColorSequenceKeypoint` values. A list must start at time 0, end at time 1 and be in time order.
@luduvo/server/global/ColorSequence.new.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: sparks that fade from yellow to red.
local sparks = Instance.new("Sparks")
sparks:AddComponent("ParticleEmitter", "ParticleSpawnRate", "ParticleColorRamp")
sparks.ParticleColorRamp.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 0), Color3.new(1, 0, 0))
sparks.Parent = self

@luduvo/server/global/ColorSequenceKeypo.documentation: ColorSequenceKeypoint creates one point of a `ColorSequence`. To read a keypoint, see `ColorSequenceKeypoint`.
`ColorSequenceKeypoint.new` creates a keypoint with `color` at `time`, from 0 to 1.
@luduvo/server/global/ColorSequenceKeypo.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local flames = Instance.new("Flames")
flames:AddComponent("ParticleEmitter", "ParticleSpawnRate", "ParticleColorRamp")
flames.ParticleColorRamp.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1, 0.9, 0.4)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, Color3.new(1, 0.4, 0)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)),
})
flames.Parent = self

@luduvo/server/global/DynamicMesh.documentation: DynamicMesh builds a 3D shape from vertices and triangles while the game runs, such as generated terrain. A dynamic mesh exists only on the client that builds it. Reserve room with `:SetCounts(vertices, indices)`, copy `count` items from byte `offset` in `data` to mesh position `start` with `:WriteVertices(data, offset, start, count)` and `:WriteIndices(data, offset, start, count)`, and show the mesh on an instance with `:Apply(target)`. A mesh takes up to 60000 vertices and 60000 indices; a client has room for 64 dynamic meshes, which share one pool of 262144 vertices and 786432 indices.

@luduvo/server/global/EventTableDump.documentation: EventTableDump prints every event table, its fields, and how many events it has queued, sent, received and refused, to help find a missing or dropped event.

@luduvo/server/global/Instance.documentation: Instance is an entity in the scene tree: a part, a light, a sound, a character or a user interface element. It has a name, a parent, children and the values of its components.

@luduvo/server/global/Instance.new.documentation: `Instance.new` creates an object of kind `name` at the top of the place and sets its `Name` to `name`. Set `Parent` after the other properties; `Instance.new` takes no parent argument.
notes: `Part` is a gray 4 by 2 by 2 box with a physics body. `Sphere`, `Cylinder`, `Cone`, `Wedge`, `SpawnLocation`, `PointLight`, `SpotLight`, `Decal`, `ParticleEmitter`, `Team`, `Tool`, `Model`, `Sound`, `BillboardGui`, `ScreenGui`, `SurfaceGui`, `Frame`, `ScrollingFrame`, `TextLabel`, `TextButton`, `TextBox`, `ImageLabel`, `ImageButton`, `Slider`, `Toggle`, `InputContext`, `InputAction`, `InputBinding` and `LeaderboardColumn` make that object; `WedgePart` makes a `Wedge`.
Any other name makes an empty instance that shows nothing until you add a shape with AddComponent.
@luduvo/server/global/Instance.new.code_sample:
-- Server script: build a staircase of five steps.
for height = 1, 5 do
    local step = Instance.new("Part")
    step.Name = "Step"
    step.Anchored = true
    step.Position = Vector3.new(0, height, height * 2)
    step.Parent = game.World
end

@luduvo/server/global/NumberRange.documentation: NumberRange creates a range of numbers, such as a particle lifetime, where each particle picks its own value between the ends. To read the ends, see `NumberRange`.

@luduvo/server/global/NumberRange.new.documentation: `NumberRange.new` creates a range from `min` to `max`, or of the one number `min` when `max` is left out.
@luduvo/server/global/NumberRange.new.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: each spark lives between 0.5 and 1.5 seconds.
local sparks = Instance.new("Sparks")
sparks:AddComponent("ParticleEmitter", "ParticleSpawnRate")
sparks.ParticleEmitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5)
sparks.Parent = self
