print(first) -- prints ColorSequenceKeypoint(0, 1, 0.5, 0)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/ColorSequenceK.documentation: Time is the keypoint's position on the curve, from 0 at the start to 1 at the end.
Value is the color at `Time`, as a vector of red, green and blue.
__eq returns true if both keypoints have the same time and color.
__tostring returns the time, red, green and blue.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Component.documentation: Component reads and writes the fields of one component on an instance. `Instance:Component` returns one; index a field name to read or write it. A built-in component uses the field names in Component views.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Component.__it.documentation: __iter visits every field of the component in declaration order, with its name and current value.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Component.__it.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:AddComponent("Timer")
local timer = self:Component("Timer")
if timer then
    timer.WaitTime = 5
    for name, value in timer do
        print(name .. " = " .. tostring(value))
    end
end
-- prints WaitTime = 5, then TimeLeft = 0

@luduvo/server/globaltype/ContentAsset.documentation: ContentAsset is one downloaded asset in memory, passed to the callback of `Content.Fetch`. The engine drops the least recently used asset when memory is full, so check `IsValid` before using an asset fetched a while ago.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/ContentAsset.I.documentation: Id is the asset id as a string of decimal digits.
IsValid returns true while the asset is still in memory.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/ContentAsset.I.code_sample:
-- Server script: spawn the obstacle course again each round.
local course: ContentAsset? = nil

game.Content.Fetch("1000000000000001", nil, function(asset)
    course = asset
end)

while true do
    task.wait(60)
    if course and course:IsValid() then
        game.Content.Spawn(course)
    end
end

@luduvo/server/globaltype/ContentAsset.S.documentation: Size is the size of the downloaded asset in bytes.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/ContentAsset.T.documentation: Type is the kind of asset: `"scene"`, `"texture"`, `"audio"`, `"mesh"`, or `"unknown"`. `Content.Spawn` spawns only `"scene"` assets.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/ContentAsset.T.code_sample:
-- Server script.
game.Content.Fetch("1000000000000001", nil, function(asset)
    if asset and asset.Type == "scene" then
        game.Content.Spawn(asset)
    end
end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/ContentRequest.documentation: ContentRequest is a content request that has not finished, returned by `Content.Fetch` and `Content.Avatar`.
Cancel stops the request, so its callback never runs. It does nothing if the request has already finished.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/ContentRequest.code_sample:
-- Server script: give up if the course has not loaded in 30 seconds.
local request = game.Content.Fetch("1000000000000001", nil, function(asset)
    if asset then
        game.Content.Spawn(asset)
    end
end)

task.wait(30)
request:Cancel()

@luduvo/server/globaltype/ContentRequest.documentation: Pending is true until the request finishes or is cancelled.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/ContentRequest.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local request = game.Content.Fetch("1000000000000001", nil, function(asset)
    if asset then
        game.Content.Spawn(asset)
    end
end)

task.wait(10)
if request.Pending then
    warn("the obstacle course is still loading")
end

@luduvo/server/globaltype/DynamicMesh.documentation: DynamicMesh builds a 3D shape from vertices and triangles while the game runs, such as generated terrain. A dynamic mesh exists only on the client that builds it. Reserve room with `:SetCounts(vertices, indices)`, copy `count` items from byte `offset` in `data` to mesh position `start` with `:WriteVertices(data, offset, start, count)` and `:WriteIndices(data, offset, start, count)`, and show the mesh on an instance with `:Apply(target)`. A mesh takes up to 60000 vertices and 60000 indices; a client has room for 64 dynamic meshes, which share one pool of 262144 vertices and 786432 indices.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventColumn.documentation: EventColumn reads the values of one field across the events an event table received this tick. Index an EventTable with a field name, `sender` or `tick` to get one, then index the column from 1 to the table's `count`.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventColumn.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local CastSpell = game.EventTable("CastSpell", game.EventTable.ToServer, {
    {"spellId", game.EventTable.U8},
    {"target", game.EventTable.Vec3},
})

function Update(dt: number)
    for i = 1, CastSpell.count do
        if CastSpell.spellId[i] == 1 then
            game.Physics.Explode(CastSpell.target[i], 8, 500)
        end
    end
end

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventDirection.documentation: EventDirection is which way an event table sends events: `game.EventTable.ToServer` from client scripts to the server, or `game.EventTable.ToClients` from the server to clients.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventFieldType.documentation: EventFieldType is the kind of value one field of an event table stores.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.documentation: EventTable is a network event table that `game.EventTable` returns. See EventTable for how to declare one and for its limits. Index it with a declared field name to get that field's EventColumn. A table can send at most 64 events in one tick; the next send raises an error.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.Fir.documentation: FireAllClients sends an event from the server to every player.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.Fir.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local RoundStarted = game.EventTable("RoundStarted", game.EventTable.ToClients, {})

task.wait(5)
RoundStarted:FireAllClients()

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.Fir.documentation: FireClient sends an event from the server to one player.
FireServer sends an event from a client script to the server, with one value per declared field.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.Fir.code_sample:
-- Client script. The server declares Buy with one String field.
local Buy = game.EventTable("Buy")

Buy:FireServer("Speed")

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.OnC.documentation: OnClientEvent is a Signal that runs on a client once for each event the server sent to it, with the field values.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.OnC.code_sample:
-- Client script in a text label. The server declares Notice
-- with one String field.
local Notice = game.EventTable("Notice")

Notice.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(text: string)
    self.Text = text
end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.OnS.documentation: OnServerEvent is a Signal that runs on the server once for each event a client sent, with the sending player and then the field values. Handlers run before `Update`, and skip events whose player has left.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.Pus.documentation: Push sends an event to every client on a `ToClients` table, or to the server on a `ToServer` table.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.Pus.deprecation: Call `FireServer` from a client script or `FireAllClients` from a server script.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.Pus.documentation: PushTo sends an event from the server to the player with a user id.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.cou.documentation: count is the number of events the table received this tick. It is 0 at the top level of a script, so read it in `Update`.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.sen.documentation: sender is the column of the user id of the player who sent each event. Only server scripts can read it, and only on a `ToServer` table.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.sen.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local Vote = game.EventTable("Vote", game.EventTable.ToServer, {
    {"choice", game.EventTable.U8},
})

function Update(dt: number)
    for i = 1, Vote.count do
        local player = game.Players.Get(Vote.sender[i])
        if player then
            player.attr.Vote = Vote.choice[i]
        end
    end
end

@luduvo/server/globaltype/EventTable.tic.documentation: tick is the column of the server tick of each event, numbered like `game.Session.ServerTick`. On the server, it is the tick of the world the sending player saw when they sent the event.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/FrameStats.documentation: FrameStats is how long each part of the engine took in the last frame, in milliseconds, and how much memory Luau uses. `game.Profiler.Frame` returns it.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/FrameStats.code_sample:
-- Client script: warn when a frame takes longer than 1/30 second.
function Update(dt: number)
    local frame = game.Profiler.Frame()
    if frame and frame.interval > 33 then
        local logic = math.round(frame.sim)
        local drawing = math.round(frame.render)
        warn(`slow frame: {logic} ms logic, {drawing} ms drawing`)
    end
end

@luduvo/server/globaltype/FrameStats.gcA.documentation: gcAllocKBs is how fast the Luau heap grows, in kilobytes per second, smoothed over recent frames in which it grew.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/FrameStats.gcK.documentation: gcKB is the size of the Luau heap in kilobytes. If it keeps rising, scripts are keeping references to data they are done with.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/FrameStats.int.documentation: interval is the time from the start of the previous frame to the start of this one, or 0 on the first frame.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/FrameStats.net.documentation: network is the time spent sending and receiving network messages.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/FrameStats.phy.documentation: physics is the time spent on physics.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/FrameStats.ren.documentation: render is the time the client took to prepare its last drawn frame. It is 0 on the server.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/FrameStats.scr.documentation: script is the time spent running Luau scripts. `game.Profiler.Scripts` gives the time per script.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/FrameStats.sim.documentation: sim is the time spent on game logic: scripts, physics and networking.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Identity.documentation: Identity is a record type for a player's user id, display name and admin flag. No engine function returns it.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Identity.displ.documentation: displayName is the player's display name.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Identity.isAdm.documentation: isAdmin is true if the player is an admin.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Identity.userI.documentation: userId is the player's user id.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.documentation: Instance is an entity in the scene tree: a part, a light, a sound, a character or a user interface element. It has a name, a parent, children and the values of its components.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Absol.documentation:
AbsoluteCanvasSize is the width and height in pixels of the canvas a scrolling frame scrolls over, as `(Width, Height, 0)`. On a frame with a vertical list or grid layout, the height is the height of its children.

Read only at runtime.

AbsolutePosition is the top-left position of a user interface element on the screen or canvas, in logical pixels: `(X, Y, 0)`.

Read only at runtime.

AbsoluteSize is the width and height of a user interface element in logical pixels: `(Width, Height, 0)`. On `game.World.Screen` it is the size of the viewport.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Actio.documentation: Action is what a button in the platform's core menu does when pressed; a button elsewhere ignores it. `"Toggle"` opens or closes the core menu and works only on the menu button of the core `TopBar` prefab.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Activ.documentation:
Activated fires on the client when a click or tap activates this element. On a tool, it fires when the holder uses it, on that client and then on the server with the player and the hit point.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Activ.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Parent = screen

button.Activated:Connect(function()
    screen.Visible = false
end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Activ.documentation: Active is the prefab id of the tool the character holds, or 0 when its hands are empty or the tool has no prefab. On the server, setting a prefab id equips the character's tool with that id, or spawns that prefab and equips it. Setting 0 unequips the tool.
ActiveAnimation returns the name of the clip the character plays, or nil when it plays none.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Activ.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
task.wait()
npc:PlayAnimation("sit")
task.wait(0.5)
print(npc:ActiveAnimation()) -- prints sit

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.AddAc.documentation: AddAccessory puts an accessory (an instance or a `ContentAsset`) on the character and returns it. The accessory needs an `Attachment` with `IsRoot` set; its `Slot` picks the socket.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.AddAc.code_sample:
-- Server script: give a character a hat.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
local hat = Instance.new("Part")
hat.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 2)
hat:AddComponent("Attachment")
hat.IsRoot = true
hat.Slot = "Hat"
print(npc:AddAccessory(hat) == hat) -- prints true

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.AddCo.documentation: AddComponent adds one or more components, built-in or declared by the place, or `Tag` pairs to the instance. Built-in components start with their default values.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.AddCo.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:AddComponent("Light", "SpotCone")
print(self:HasComponent("SpotCone")) -- prints true

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Adorn.documentation: Adornee is the 3D instance the handles go on. While it is nil, the handles do not show.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Advan.documentation: AdvancePreview advances a playing animation preview by the time since it last advanced, and returns whether the pose changed. A paused preview does not advance.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Advan.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local rig = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
task.wait()
rig:PreviewAnimation("walk", true)
task.wait(0.5)
print(rig:AdvancePreview()) -- prints true

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.AirAc.documentation: AirAccelerate is how fast the character speeds up in the air toward the movement keys, in multiples of `WalkSpeed` per second. Turning while strafing keeps adding speed.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.AirJu.documentation:
AirJumps is how many jumps the character has made in the air since it last landed.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.AirMa.documentation: AirMaxWishSpeed is the speed, in units/s, at which holding the movement keys in a straight line in the air stops adding speed. Strafing still builds speed past it.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Albed.documentation: Albedo is the asset id of the texture that gives a mesh its base colors, along the mesh's UV coordinates. `"0"` shows the part's `Color` or its material's textures.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Align.documentation: Align places a list's children across the direction it stacks them: `"Start"`, `"Center"` or `"End"`. It is horizontal when `Axis` is `"Vertical"` and vertical when `Axis` is `"Horizontal"`.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Ambie.documentation: AmbientLightColor is the sRGB color of the ambient light, the light that fills shadows and surfaces no light reaches.
AmbientLightEnergy is the brightness of the ambient light, from 0 to 16. At 0, surfaces in shadow are dark.

AmbientLightSkyContribution is how much of the ambient light comes from the sky instead of AmbientLightColor, from 0 to 1. At 1, upward faces get the sky's color and downward faces get light bounced off the ground.
AmbientLightSource is where the ambient light comes from, one of `game.Enum.AmbientSource`:

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Ancho.documentation: Anchor is the pivot of a swing-twist joint, in units in the parent part's frame. The joint links this part to its parent part and forms when this part has a dynamic body.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Ancho.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: hang a lantern under it that swings up to 30 degrees.
self.Anchored = true

local lantern = Instance.new("Part")
lantern.Size = Vector3.new(1, 2, 1)
lantern.Position = self.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
lantern.Parent = self
lantern.Anchor = Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)
lantern.TwistAxis = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
lantern.PlaneCone = 30
lantern.NormalCone = 30

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Ancho.documentation: AnchorPoint is the point of the element that its position places, as a fraction of its size: (0, 0) is the top left, (0.5, 0.5) the center and (1, 1) the bottom right.

Anchored locks the part in place, so gravity, collisions and forces do not move it. One anchored part makes its whole welded assembly static, but a part welded to a character follows the character even when anchored.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Angle.documentation: Angle turns the texture, in degrees, around the UV center (0.5, 0.5).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Angul.documentation: AngularDamping is the drag that slows the body's spin. 0 is no drag.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.AnimL.documentation:
AnimLayers lists the animation layers that blend together on this character.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.AnimL.code_sample:
-- Server script: blend a looping climb into a character's pose for 2 s.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
task.wait()
local layer = game.Animation.FirstScriptLayer
npc.AnimLayers[layer] = { clip = "climb", weight = 0.5, loop = true }
task.wait(2)
npc.AnimLayers[layer] = nil

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Anima.documentation: AnimationPreview returns the open animation preview as a table with `clip`, `time` in seconds, `speed`, `playing` and `shared`, or nil when no preview is open.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Anima.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local rig = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
task.wait()
rig:PreviewAnimation("walk", false)
local info = assert(rig:AnimationPreview())
print(info.clip) -- prints walk

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Anima.documentation: AnimationWeight returns how much of the character's pose a clip makes up, from 0 to 1, or nil when no clip has that name.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Anima.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
task.wait()
npc:PlayAnimation("sit")
task.wait(1)
print(npc:AnimationWeight("sit")) -- prints 1

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Apply.documentation: ApplyForce pushes the part with a world-space force for the next physics step. Calls in the same step add up, so a steady push needs a call every step. The optional `at` is the world point where the force acts; without it, the force acts at the center of mass, or at the part's own position when the part is welded to another part. ApplyForce warns and does nothing on a part without a dynamic body, such as an anchored part.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Apply.code_sample:
-- Server script in a rocket: push it up with twice its weight.
self.Anchored = false
task.wait()
local thrust = -2 * game.Physics.Gravity * assert(self:GetMass())
while task.wait() do
    self:ApplyForce(Vector3.new(0, thrust, 0))
end

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Apply.documentation: ApplyImpulse gives the part a sudden world-space push that changes its velocity at once. The optional `at` works as for ApplyForce. ApplyImpulse warns and does nothing on a part without a dynamic body.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Apply.code_sample:
-- Server script in a ball: kick it up at 50 units per second.
self.Anchored = false
task.wait()
self:ApplyImpulse(Vector3.new(0, 50 * assert(self:GetMass()), 0))

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Apply.documentation: ApplyTorque twists the part with a torque for the next physics step.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Apply.deprecation: Attach `SubstepTorque` with Instance:AddComponent and write the `SubstepTorque` column on World.Query.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Apply.documentation: ApplyTorqueImpulse gives the part a sudden world-space twist that changes its spin at once. It warns and does nothing on a part without a dynamic body.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Apply.code_sample:
-- Server script in a spinning top.
self.Anchored = false
task.wait()
self:ApplyTorqueImpulse(Vector3.new(0, 50, 0))

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Area.documentation: Area is the wing area in square units. Every physics step, lift is `0.5 * air density * Area * speed ^ 2 * C_L` and drag is the same with `C_D`. `speed` is only the airflow across the span (the part's X axis); the chord runs along -Z and lift acts toward the part's +Y. On an assembly member the forces push the whole assembly.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Area.code_sample:
-- Server script in a flat wing part, so it glides instead of dropping.
self.Size = Vector3.new(8, 0.2, 2)
self:AddComponent("AeroSurface")
self.Area = 16
self.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, -60)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Arrow.documentation: ArrowDirection is the direction the button's arrow points: `"Left"`, `"Right"`, `"Up"` or `"Down"`.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Aspec.documentation: AspectRatio is the element's width divided by its height; 0 keeps the shape that `Size` gives. The element takes the largest box of this ratio that fits in its `Size`, so `Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.2, 0)` with `AspectRatio = 1` is a square on any screen.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Assem.documentation: Assembly makes a Model one rigid body when true. A plain model is a group.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Asset.documentation:
Asset is the asset id the accessory was spawned from, or `"0"` for an accessory built in the place.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Attac.documentation:
Attacker is the instance that last damaged the character with `TakeDamage`, or nil.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Attac.code_sample:
-- Server script in a trap part.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc:TakeDamage(10, self)
print(npc.Attacker == self) -- prints true

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Attri.documentation:
AttributeChanged fires with the attribute name when an attribute in `attr` changes or is removed, by a script or by the server.

Read only at runtime.
notes: The engine compares attributes once per tick, before `Update` runs. Several writes to one name in a tick fire once, writing the same value again does not fire, and a change made while nothing is connected does not fire later.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Attri.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(name)
    print(name, self.attr[name])
end)
self.attr.Coins = 5
self.attr.Coins = 7 -- same tick: fires once, prints Coins 7

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.AutoL.documentation: AutoLocomotion plays the character's walk, idle and jump animations from how it moves. It needs CharacterAnimation.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.AutoR.documentation: AutoRotate turns the character to face the direction it walks. Shift lock turns it toward the camera direction instead.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Axis.documentation: Axis is the direction a list stacks its children: `"Vertical"` top to bottom, or `"Horizontal"` left to right.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Axle.documentation: Axle is the direction the wheel spins around, in the wheel's own frame. The default spins a `Cylinder` wheel the way it rolls.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Backg.documentation: BackgroundColor is the sRGB color behind everything when the Environment has no `AtmosphereSky`, `PanoramaSky` or `SixSidedSky`.
BackgroundColor3 is the fill color of the element's background.
BackgroundEnergyMultiplier is the brightness, from 0 to 16, of the background color and of panorama and six-sided skies. The atmosphere sky ignores it.
BackgroundMode is whether the Environment draws a sky or clears to BackgroundColor.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Backg.deprecation: Add `AtmosphereSky`, `PanoramaSky` or `SixSidedSky` with Instance:AddComponent, or remove them with Instance:RemoveComponent.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Backg.documentation: BackgroundTransparency is the transparency of the element's background, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Backp.documentation:
BackpackChanged fires on a character when its hotbar changes: a tool enters or leaves a slot, the held tool changes, or a slotted tool's `Tool.icon` or `Name` changes. Several changes in one tick fire it once. See Tools.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Backp.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc.BackpackChanged:Connect(function()
    local tool = npc:GetTool()
    print("holding " .. (if tool then tool.Name else "nothing")) -- prints holding Tool
end)
npc:EquipTool(Instance.new("Tool"))

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Backp.documentation: BackpackSlot is the hotbar slot of a tool, 1 to 10, or 0 for none.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BarWi.documentation: BarWidth is the width in pixels of the hue strip along the right edge of a color picker.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Billb.documentation: BillboardColor is the text color of the camera-facing 3D billboard label.
BillboardMaxDistance is how far from the camera, in world units, the billboard text shows; it fades out near this distance. 0 shows it at any distance.
BillboardOffset is the center of the billboard text, in world units from the instance's position.
BillboardOnTop, when true, draws the billboard text in front of everything.
BillboardScreenSize is the part of the text height in screen points, the same at any distance. It adds to BillboardWorldSize.
BillboardText is the text of the camera-facing 3D billboard label. An empty string hides the label.
BillboardWorldSize is the part of the text height in world units, which looks smaller farther away. It adds to BillboardScreenSize.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BodyC.documentation: BodyColorHead is the color of the `Head` part when the part has no `Color` of its own. Until a script sets it, the head keeps its default color.
BodyColorLeftArm is the color of the `LeftArm` part when the part has no `Color` of its own. Until a script sets it, the left arm keeps its default color.
BodyColorLeftLeg is the color of the `LeftLeg` part when the part has no `Color` of its own. Until a script sets it, the left leg keeps its default color.
BodyColorRightArm is the color of the `RightArm` part when the part has no `Color` of its own. Until a script sets it, the right arm keeps its default color.
BodyColorRightLeg is the color of the `RightLeg` part when the part has no `Color` of its own. Until a script sets it, the right leg keeps its default color.
BodyColorTorso is the color of the `Torso` part when the part has no `Color` of its own. Until a script sets it, the torso keeps its default color.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BodyH.documentation: BodyHead is the asset id of the head mesh, or `"0"` for the bundled mesh.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BodyL.documentation: BodyLeftArm is the asset id of the left arm mesh, or `"0"` for the bundled mesh.
BodyLeftLeg is the asset id of the left leg mesh, or `"0"` for the bundled mesh.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BodyR.documentation: BodyRightArm is the asset id of the right arm mesh, or `"0"` for the bundled mesh.
BodyRightLeg is the asset id of the right leg mesh, or `"0"` for the bundled mesh.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BodyT.documentation: BodyTorso is the asset id of the torso mesh, or `"0"` for the bundled mesh.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Bold.documentation: Bold reads true when FontWeight is 600 or more. Writing true sets `FontWeight` to 700 and false sets it to 400.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Borde.documentation: BorderColor3 is the color of the border around the element.

BorderFocusOnly, when true, draws the border only while a text box on or inside the element is typed in or is `game.Input.Selected`. That text box then draws no selection ring, so a search field shows one outline around the whole field.
BorderSizePixel is the width in pixels of the border, drawn inside the element's edges; 0 draws none.
BorderTransparency is the transparency of the border, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BoxCo.documentation: BoxColor3 is the fill color of a checkbox's box.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BoxTr.documentation: BoxTransparency is the transparency of a checkbox's box, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Branc.documentation: BranchColor3 is the color of the lines that join parent and child nodes in a tree view.
BranchTransparency is the transparency of the tree view lines.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Break.documentation: BreakForce is the reaction force in Newtons that breaks the part's weld or assembly link. When a physics step pulls harder, the part and the members below it fly off as one body. 0 never breaks, and a weld to a character never breaks.
BreakLink breaks the part off its parent or weld target. The part and everything welded under it fly on as one body at the velocity of the link point, and the part keeps its place in the hierarchy.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Break.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: weld a wing to it, then break the wing off.
local wing = Instance.new("Part")
wing.Position = self.Position + Vector3.new(3, 0, 0)
wing.Parent = game.World
wing.Other = self

task.wait(1)
wing:BreakLink()
print(wing.Other) -- prints nil

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Break.documentation: BreakTorque is the reaction torque in Newton-meters that breaks the part's weld or assembly link, as BreakForce does for force.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Brigh.documentation: Brightness is the value (the V of HSV) picked in a color picker, from 0 (black) to 1. Dragging up or down changes it.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Bus.documentation: Bus is the mix bus the sound plays through: `"Master"`, `"Music"`, `"SFX"` or `"UI"`. The sound plays at `Volume * bus volume * Master volume`, and on `"Master"` the Master volume counts once.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BusyC.documentation: BusyColor3 is the color of the moving segment of a busy progress bar, one that shows work with no known end.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BusyS.documentation: BusySpeed is how many times a second a busy progress bar sweeps. Positive values sweep left to right, negative values sweep right to left, and 0 stops it.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BusyT.documentation: BusyTransparency is the transparency of the moving segment of a busy progress bar.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.BusyW.documentation: BusyWidth is the width of the moving segment as a fraction of the bar's width, drawn clamped to 0 to 1.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Camer.documentation:
perspective projection settings for a camera entity

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Cance.documentation: CancelText is the cancel button text; empty shows Cancel.

Canceled fires when the player cancels the dialog.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Cance.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local ui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ui.Parent = game.Overlay
local dialog = Instance.new("Frame")
dialog.DialogTitle = "Quit"
dialog.Parent = ui
dialog.Canceled:Connect(function() print("stay") end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Canva.documentation: CanvasPosition is the vertical scroll offset of a scrolling frame in pixels, as `(0, Y, 0)`. Writing it scrolls the frame, and a `ScrollFollowing` frame then stops following until the player scrolls back to the end.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Canva.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local pane = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
pane.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1000)
pane.Parent = screen

-- Back to the top after swapping pages.
pane.CanvasPosition = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
print(pane.CanvasPosition.Y) -- prints 0

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Canva.documentation: CanvasSize is the size of the area a scrolling frame scrolls over. When the area is wider or taller than the frame, the frame scrolls that way.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.CellP.documentation: CellPadding is the gap in pixels between neighboring cells of a grid, across and down.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.CellS.documentation: CellSize is the width and height in pixels of each cell of a grid. The grid's children take this size instead of their own.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Cente.documentation: CenterOfPressure is the point where lift and drag act, in the part's frame relative to its position. An offset from the center of mass makes lift and drag turn the body.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chang.documentation: ChangeState puts a character into a movement state at its next physics step, so `State` keeps the old name until then. A `"Ragdoll"` character goes limp and gets up once it is at rest after at least 1 second, or after 8 seconds; a `"FallingDown"` character gets up after 3 seconds. These are the defaults of the place's character tuning.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chang.code_sample:
-- Server script: knock a character over.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc:ChangeState("Ragdoll")
print(npc.State) -- prints FreeFall
task.wait(0.1)
print(npc.State) -- prints Ragdoll

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chang.documentation:
Changed fires on the client when the player edits the text of this text box, with the property name `"Text"`. Script writes do not fire it; use GetPropertyChangedSignal for those.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chang.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
box.Parent = screen
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Parent = screen
box.Changed:Connect(function(property)
    if property == "Text" then
        label.Text = box.Text
    end
end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chara.documentation:
Character is the character this instance is or controls: a player gives its character, a character root gives itself, a body part gives its character root, and any other instance gives nil.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chara.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part: kill any character that touches it.
self.Touched:Connect(function(hit: Instance)
    local character = hit.Character
    if character then
        character.Health = 0
    end
end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chara.documentation:
CharacterAdded fires when a character spawns for this player, on the first spawn and on every respawn. The callback receives the character. On a client it does not fire for a character that existed before the client scripts started; read `player.Character` instead.

Read only at runtime.
CharacterAnimation animates the body parts under the character root. A part without `BodyPart` is not animated: it moves with the torso and never collides with it.
CharacterPhysics gives the torso a physics body so the character moves under physics. The character controller also needs `Locomotion`; without it the instance is an ordinary physics body.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chara.code_sample:
-- Server script: make a block that walks like a character.
local mob = Instance.new("Mob")
mob:AddComponent("Shape")
mob.Size = Vector3.new(2, 3, 2)
mob:AddComponent("CharacterPhysics")
mob:AddComponent("Locomotion")
mob.WalkSpeed = 8

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chara.documentation: CharacterRig gives the limbs physics bodies that follow the torso and the animation. It needs CharacterPhysics. The limbs collide only in the `"Ragdoll"`, `"FallingDown"` and `"Dead"` states.
CharacterSurfaceAlign turns UpDirection toward the normal of the floor the character stands on, so it can walk up walls. It needs GravityVector.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chass.documentation: Chassis is the body this wheel hangs from. The wheel spins around `Axle` and moves up and down `Travel` units on a spring; it does not collide with its chassis. The joint forms only between parts with physics bodies in different assemblies, and setting nil or destroying either part removes it.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chass.code_sample:
-- Server script in a level car body part: put a wheel under each corner and drive.
local corners = {
    Vector3.new(-3.5, -1, 4), Vector3.new(3.5, -1, 4),
    Vector3.new(-3.5, -1, -4), Vector3.new(3.5, -1, -4),
}
for _, corner in corners do
    local wheel = Instance.new("Cylinder")
    wheel.Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 1, 2.4)
    wheel.Position = self.Position + corner
    wheel.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 90)
    wheel.Parent = game.World
    wheel.Chassis = self
    wheel.DriveTorque = 2000
    wheel.SpinSpeed = 10
end

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Chatt.documentation:
Chatted fires on the server when this player sends a chat message. The callback receives the message text.

Read only at runtime.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Check.documentation: CheckColor3 is the color of a checkbox's check mark.
CheckTransparency is the transparency of the check mark, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).
Checked, when true, shows the checkbox's check mark. Clicking the checkbox flips it and fires `Activated`.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Child.documentation:
ChildAdded fires with the child when an instance becomes a direct child of this one: a new instance, a moved one, a clone or a child that replicates from the server. Deeper descendants do not fire it.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Child.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    print("added " .. child.Name) -- prints added Lamp
end)
local lamp = Instance.new("Part")
lamp.Name = "Lamp"
lamp.Parent = self

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Child.documentation:
ChildRemoved fires with the child when a direct child moves to another parent or is destroyed. A destroyed child cannot be indexed, but it is still the same table key, so a script can use it to clean up.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Child.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local lamp = Instance.new("Part")
lamp.Name = "Lamp"
lamp.Parent = self

self.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
    print(child == lamp) -- prints true
end)
lamp:Destroy()

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Circl.documentation: CircleColor3 is the color of a radio button's outer ring.
CircleTransparency is the transparency of a radio button's outer ring, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Climb.documentation: Climbable makes characters that walk into the part climb it, as on a ladder. A character climbs a moving ladder as if the ladder stood still and rides along when it holds still.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Clips.documentation: ClipsDescendants, when true, cuts off the elements under this one at its edges.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Clone.documentation: Clone returns a copy of the instance and all its descendants. The copy has a new id and no parent until you set one.
notes: The copy keeps the attributes and tags of the original and runs its own copy of every script attached to it, with `self` set to the copy. A script that clones the part it runs on therefore also runs in the clone and clones again.
The copy has no `SessionOwner`, so a cloned character belongs to no player and `player.Character` stays on the original.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Clone.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local crate = Instance.new("Part")
crate.Name = "Crate"
crate.Parent = game.World

local copy = crate:Clone()
copy.Parent = game.World
copy.Position = crate.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
print(copy.Name, copy == crate) -- prints Crate false

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Cloud.documentation: CloudAnisotropy is which way clouds scatter sunlight. Positive values make clouds brightest when the camera looks toward the sun, negative values when the sun is behind the camera, and 0 scatters evenly. Values are clamped to `[-0.98, 0.98]`.
CloudBaseHeight is the height, in units above y = 0, of the bottom of the cloud layer, from 1 to 100000. A higher base also makes the cloud shapes larger.
CloudBottomDarkening is how much darker cloud bottoms are than their tops, from 0 to 1.
CloudCoverage is how much of the sky the clouds cover, from 0 (clear) to 1 (an unbroken layer); around 0.3 gives scattered patches.

CloudDensity is how thick the cloud is per unit of distance, from 0 to 1. 0 makes clouds invisible. Values from about 0.005 to 0.02 give white clouds; higher values turn them gray and then storm dark.
CloudErosion is how much cloud edges break into wisps, clamped to `[0, 0.99]`. At 0 clouds keep smooth shapes.
CloudEvolutionSpeed is how fast the clouds change shape, from 0 to 100, apart from drifting with the wind. At 0 they keep their shape.
CloudMultipleScattering is how much light bounces inside the clouds, from 0 to 2. Higher values lighten the inside of thick clouds.
CloudPowderStrength is how much the thin edges of thick clouds brighten against the sun, from 0 to 2. 0 turns it off.

CloudQuality is how many steps the renderer takes through the clouds per pixel: 0 is 16 steps, 1 is 24, and 2 or more is 32. Graphics quality Levels 3 to 5 always take 16 steps, and Levels 9 and 10 take 64 in place of 32.
CloudSeed is a whole number from 0 to 2147483647 that picks the random layout of the clouds.
CloudShadowStrength is how dark cloud shadows on the ground are, from 0 to 4. 0 casts no cloud shadows, and 1 casts the physical shadow.
CloudThickness is how tall the cloud layer is, in units from 1 to 50000. Low values make flat sheets and high values let clouds tower.
CloudWindSpeed is how fast the clouds drift, in units/s from 0 to 1000, along (CloudWindX, CloudWindZ).
CloudWindX is the X part, from -1 to 1, of the direction the clouds drift. When `CloudWindX` and `CloudWindZ` are both 0, the clouds drift along +X.
CloudWindZ is the Z part, from -1 to 1, of the direction the clouds drift.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Colli.documentation: Collider is the collision shape of the part, separate from its visual shape.
CollisionGroup is the name of the collision group that decides what this part collides with. A group must be registered with game.Physics.RegisterCollisionGroup before a part can join it.
notes: On a character, every limb joins the group too.

A character in `"Default"`, `"Character"` or `"CharacterNoCollide"` walks through the sides of a part whose group does not collide with its group, but still stands on its top; set the part's `Trigger` to let it fall through. A character in a group a script registered falls through such a part.
A part parented under a character never collides with that character, and the character never stands on it.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Colli.code_sample:
-- Server script in a floor part: ghost crates fall through it.
self.Anchored = true
game.Physics.RegisterCollisionGroup("Ghost")
game.Physics.SetCollisionRule("Ghost", "Default", false)

local crate = Instance.new("Part")
crate.CollisionGroup = "Ghost"
crate.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
crate.Parent = game.World
task.wait(2)
print(crate.Position.y < 0) -- prints true

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Color.documentation: Color tints the part's base color, its mesh texture, or a decal's image. It is an sRGB color: `Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)` leaves the texture as it is and `Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)` makes it black.
notes: Any write, black included, turns a mesh with a texture id such as Albedo into a clothing layer: the mesh file's textures are not used, and Underlay, then `Albedo`, blend over `Color`.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Colum.documentation: ColumnWidths is the width in pixels of up to 16 columns of a grid or table. A non-zero entry replaces the shared cell width for that column; entries left out are 0.
Columns is the number of columns of a grid before items wrap to the next line, clamped between 1 and 8192 in layout.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Compo.documentation: Component returns a view of one component of the instance, or nil when the instance does not have it. The view reads and writes the same values as the flat properties.
notes: Reading or writing a view after the instance lost the component is an error; a view never adds the component.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Compo.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:AddComponent("Health")
local health = self:Component("Health")
if health then
    health.MaxHealth = 200
end
print(self.MaxHealth) -- prints 200
print(self:Component("Light")) -- prints nil

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.ConeI.documentation: ConeInnerAngle is the full angle, in degrees, of the cone in which the sound plays at full volume. The cone points out of the instance's Front face (-Z) and turns with it. At 360 the sound is the same in every direction.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.ConeO.documentation: ConeOuterAngle is the full angle, in degrees, of the cone outside which the sound plays at ConeOuterGain. Between ConeInnerAngle and this angle, the volume drops linearly.
ConeOuterGain is the volume multiplier outside ConeOuterAngle. 0 silences the sound there.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Confi.documentation: ConfirmText is the confirm button text; empty shows OK.

Confirmed fires when the player accepts the dialog.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Confi.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local ui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ui.Parent = game.Overlay
local dialog = Instance.new("Frame")
dialog.DialogTitle = "Quit"
dialog.Parent = ui
dialog.Confirmed:Connect(function() print("ok") end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Conne.documentation: ConnectedAnchor is where the rope attaches to `ConnectedRigidbody`, in units in that part's frame.

ConnectedBody is the part this part is linked to by a hinge around `HingeAxis` at `HingeAnchor`. The hinge forms only between parts with physics bodies in different assemblies, and setting nil or destroying either part removes it.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Conne.code_sample:
-- Server script in a door frame part: hang a door on its left edge.
self.Anchored = true

local door = Instance.new("Part")
door.Size = Vector3.new(4, 7, 0.2)
door.Position = self.Position + Vector3.new(2, 0, 0)
door.Parent = game.World
door.HingeAnchor = Vector3.new(-2, 0, 0)
door.HingeAxis = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
door.UseLimits = true
door.LimitsMin = -90
door.LimitsMax = 90
door.ConnectedBody = self

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Conne.documentation: ConnectedRigidbody is the part this part is tied to by a rope that keeps them at most `Distance` units apart. The rope forms only between parts with physics bodies in different assemblies, and setting nil or destroying either part removes it.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Conne.code_sample:
-- Server script in a ceiling part: hang a lamp on a 6-unit rope.
self.Anchored = true

local lamp = Instance.new("Part")
lamp.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
lamp.Position = self.Position - Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
lamp.Parent = game.World
lamp.Distance = 6
lamp.ConnectedRigidbody = self

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Conso.documentation: ConsolePrompt, when true, makes this element the developer console command input.
ConsoleRowLine, when true, makes this element show the text of a developer console message.
ConsoleRowPrefix, when true, makes this element show the time or source of a developer console message.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Conti.documentation: ContinuousCollision stops a small fast body from passing through other bodies. It costs more simulation time.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.CoreM.documentation: CoreMenuDimmer marks a descendant of the core menu as the menu's backdrop, which fades in and out with the menu. Only the first one marked counts.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Corne.documentation: CornerRadii is the radius in pixels of each corner of the background: `Min.X` and `Min.Y` are top-left and top-right, and `Max.X` and `Max.Y` are bottom-right and bottom-left. When all four are 0, CornerRadius applies.
CornerRadius is the radius in pixels of the corners of the background and border, never more than half the element's width or height.
CorneringStiffness is the sideways grip a tire gains per radian of slip angle, as a multiple of its load. A stiffer tire reaches `PeakFriction`, and starts to slide, at a smaller angle.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Curso.documentation: Cursor is the cursor shape shown while the pointer is over the element. It takes a name from `game.Enum.CursorShape`, such as `"Pointer"` or `"Text"`. `"Auto"` uses the nearest ancestor's cursor.
CursorColor3 is the color of the blinking caret of a text box being typed in.

CursorPosition is the byte position of the caret in a focused text box, counted from 1 as `string.sub` counts, or -1 while the box has no focus. Writing it moves the caret; without focus, a write does nothing.
CursorTransparency is the transparency of the caret, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Densi.documentation: Density is the mass per cubic unit of the part, so its mass is `Density * volume`. A part without its own Density reads its material's density, or 0.7 without a material.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Destr.documentation: Destroy deletes the instance and all its descendants at once and disconnects their signal connections. It does nothing on an instance that is already destroyed.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Destr.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local bullet = Instance.new("Part")
bullet.Parent = game.World
task.delay(2, function()
    bullet:Destroy()
    print(bullet:IsAlive()) -- prints false
end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Direc.documentation: DirectionalColor is the sRGB color of the sunlight. The light shines along the instance's `Orientation`; only the first directional light in the world lights the scene.
DirectionalEnergy is the brightness of the sunlight, from 0 to 20. At 0 surfaces get only ambient light.
DirectionalShadowFill is the share of diffuse sunlight that still reaches surfaces in the sun's shadow. 0 leaves shadows dark, and 1 lights them fully except for the sun's highlight.
DirectionalShadowMode is whether the sun casts shadows: `"None"` casts none, and `"Hard"` casts sharp-edged shadows out to MaxDistance from the camera.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Disab.documentation: Disabled, when true, dims the element and stops it from taking the pointer, so no hover, click or activation events fire.
DisabledImage is the asset id of the image shown in place of `Image` while the element or any ancestor is disabled. `"0"` keeps `Image`.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Displ.documentation: DisplayName is the name on the character's nametag and in the player list.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Dista.documentation: Distance is the longest the rope stretches, in units. The parts can move closer. A running rope motor changes Distance as it reels.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.DockP.documentation: DockPrefab is the name of a prefab whose spawned UI root draws in this element's box instead of its own. Writing it adds the `UIDock` component. While the root exists, this element and its children do not draw. Writing `""` returns both to their own places, and destroying either restores the other.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.DotCo.documentation: DotColor3 is the color of the dot of a selected radio button.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.DotTr.documentation: DotTransparency is the transparency of a radio button's dot, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Down.documentation: Down is the Input.Key on an `InputBinding` that adds -1 on Y to a `Direction2D` action while held. 0 binds no key.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.DragE.documentation:
DragEnded fires on the client when the player finishes dragging this control. It passes true if the drag changed the control's value.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.DragE.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Parent = screen

button.DragEnded:Connect(function(edited)
    print("drag ended", edited)
end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.DragM.documentation:
DragMoved fires on the client while a pointer drags this control. It passes the movement in pixels. On adornment handles it passes the face index and the distance in units.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.DragM.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Parent = screen

button.DragMoved:Connect(function(dx, dy)
    button.UIRect.Position += UDim2.fromOffset(dx, dy)
end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Drive.documentation: DriveTorque is the most torque the wheel's motor applies to reach `SpinSpeed`. At 0 the wheel rolls freely.

Drives is the character control an `InputAction` drives, so a touch stick, a UI button or a key can make the local character walk or jump. `"Move"` walks along a `Direction2D` action's vector (+Y forward from the camera, its length the fraction of walk speed); `"Jump"` jumps while a `Bool` action is on.
notes: The action drives the character only while the escape menu is closed and InputMove is true on the default camera.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Drive.code_sample:
-- Client script: the J key also makes the character jump.
local controls = Instance.new("InputContext")
local jump = Instance.new("InputAction")
jump.Drives = "Jump"
jump.Parent = controls
local j = Instance.new("InputBinding")
j.KeyCode = game.Input.Key.J
j.Parent = jump

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Emiss.documentation: Emissive is the asset id of a texture that makes parts of a mesh glow in any light; black gives no glow. `"0"` means none.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Emit.documentation: Emit fires a named signal on the instance and runs every connected function before it returns.
notes: Emit does nothing unless a script created this signal with GetSignal. With no connected function, it prints `signal '<name>' fired with no connected handlers`.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Emit.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:GetSignal("Alert"):Connect(function(level)
    print("alert level " .. level) -- prints alert level 3
end)
self:Emit("Alert", 3)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Enabl.documentation: Enabled is whether an `InputContext` or `InputAction` takes input. Turning off a context turns off every action under it.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Equip.documentation: EquipTool puts a tool in this character's hand. A tool without a slot gets the lowest free one. The tool the character held before goes back to its slot.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Equip.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
local pistol = Instance.new("Tool")
pistol.Name = "Pistol"
npc:EquipTool(pistol)
print(assert(npc:GetTool()).Name) -- prints Pistol

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Equip.documentation:
Equipped fires when a character equips this tool, on the server and on the client of the player who equips it. The callback receives the player, or nil for a character no player controls.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Equip.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local sword = Instance.new("Tool")
sword.Equipped:Connect(function(player: Instance?)
    print("equipped by " .. (if player then player.Name else "an NPC"))
end)
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc:EquipTool(sword) -- prints equipped by an NPC

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Face.documentation: Face is the asset id of the face texture, or `"0"` for none.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FillA.documentation: FillAmount is how much of a round progress fill shows, from 0 (empty) to 1 (the full circle).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FillC.documentation: FillColor3 is the color of the slider track between its start and the thumb.
FillColumns, when true, fits as many `CellSize.X` columns across a grid as its inner width has room for, ignoring `Columns`. `FitColumns` and `ColumnWidths` override it.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FillI.documentation: FillImage is the asset id of the image on the filled part of the slider track. `"0"` draws plain `FillColor3`.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FillM.documentation: FillMode is the way a round progress fill sweeps: `"Clockwise"`, `"Counterclockwise"`, or `"BothWays"` from the top center.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FillT.documentation: FillTransparency is the transparency of the filled part of the slider track, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FindA.documentation: FindAncestorWithComponent returns the instance itself or its nearest ancestor that has the named component or Pair, or nil when none has it.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FindA.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local hat = Instance.new("Part")
hat.Parent = self
self:AddComponent("Light")
print(hat:FindAncestorWithComponent("Light") == self) -- prints true

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FindF.documentation: FindFirstChild returns the first child with a matching `Name`, or nil. With `recursive` set to true it searches every descendant, nearest levels first.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FindF.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local lamp = Instance.new("Part")
lamp.Name = "Lamp"
lamp.Parent = self

print(self:FindFirstChild("Lamp") == lamp) -- prints true
print(self:FindFirstChild("Door")) -- prints nil

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FitCo.documentation: FitColumns, when true, makes each grid column as wide as its widest cell.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Flare.documentation: FlareGhostIntensity is the brightness, from 0 to 10, of the extra reflections of the sun's lens flare. 0 keeps only the main flare disk.
FlareIntensity is the brightness, from 0 to 10, of the sun's lens flare and sun rays; 0 turns both off.
FlareRaysIntensity is the brightness, from 0 to 10, of the rays of light around the sun that shine past clouds and objects. Rays draw only at graphics quality Level 6 and above.
FlareScale multiplies the size of every lens flare element, from 0.1 to 5.
FlareTint is the sRGB tint of the lens flare and the sun rays.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Float.documentation: Floating, when true, takes the element out of its parent's list or grid layout. Its `Position` and `AnchorPoint` place it in the parent's box.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Focus.documentation:
FocusLost fires on the client when this text box loses keyboard focus. The callback receives true when the player pressed the return key.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Focus.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
box.Parent = screen
box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
    if enterPressed then
        print("submitted " .. box.Text)
    end
end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Focus.documentation:
Focused fires on the client when this text box gains keyboard focus from a click, a tap or CaptureFocus.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Focus.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
box.Parent = screen
box.Focused:Connect(function()
    box.PlaceholderText = ""
end)
box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    box.PlaceholderText = "Search"
end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FogCo.documentation: FogColor is the sRGB color of the fog that objects blend into with distance. The fog is lit by the same sun and sky as the ground. The sky is not fogged.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FogDe.documentation: FogDensity is how thick the fog is in the `"Exponential"` and `"ExponentialSquared"` modes, from 0 to 1.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FogEn.documentation: FogEnd is the distance from the camera, in units, where `"Linear"` fog hides objects fully.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FogMo.documentation: FogMode is how the fog thickens with distance, one of `game.Enum.FogMode`:

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FogSt.documentation: FogStart is the distance from the camera, in units, where `"Linear"` fog begins.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Folde.documentation: Folded, when true, collapses the tree node and hides everything under it.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FontF.documentation: FontFamily is the typeface of the text: `"Arimo"`, `"Montserrat"`, `"Fredoka"`, `"Nunito"`, `"Roboto"`, `"RobotoMono"`, `"Oswald"`, `"Merriweather"`, `"Bangers"`, `"LuckiestGuy"`, `"PressStart2P"`, `"PermanentMarker"` or `"Creepster"`. Spaces and case do not count, so `"Press Start 2P"` works. A character the family lacks draws in Arimo, then in the emoji font.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.FontW.documentation: FontWeight is the weight of the text, from 100 (thin) through 400 (regular) and 700 (bold) to 900 (black). Values clamp between 1 and 1000.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Freez.documentation: FreezePosition locks movement along world axes: X 1, Y 2, Z 4. Add the values to lock several axes.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Freez.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part that slides only up and down.
self.FreezePosition = 1 + 4 -- X and Z

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Freez.documentation: FreezeRotation locks rotation around world axes: X 1, Y 2, Z 4. Add the values to lock several axes.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Freez.code_sample:
-- Server script in a crate that must not tip over.
self.FreezeRotation = 1 + 4 -- X and Z

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Freez.documentation: FreezeRows is the number of header lines that stay at the top of a scrolling table while the others scroll under them.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Frict.documentation: Friction is the friction coefficient of the part's surface. 0 is frictionless. A part without its own Friction reads its material's friction, or 0.2 without a material.
FrictionTorque is the torque in Newton-meters that keeps a settled swing-twist joint still. At 0 the joint turns freely.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetAc.documentation: GetAccessories returns an array of the accessories this character wears.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetAc.deprecation: Iterate `WornBy` pairs with World.Each and World.Pair.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetAn.documentation: GetAngularVelocity returns the world angular velocity of the physics body in radians per second.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetAt.documentation: GetAttributeChangedSignal returns a Signal that fires when the named attribute in `attr` takes a new value, whether a script or the server changed it. The attribute does not need to exist yet.
notes: The engine compares the value once per tick, before `Update` runs, and fires once with no arguments. Adding, removing and changing the type of the attribute each count as a change.
Each connected signal adds one comparison per tick, so disconnect it when the handler has nothing left to do.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetAt.code_sample:
-- Server script in a door part.
self:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Open"):Connect(function()
    self.Transparency = if self.attr.Open then 0.5 else 0
    print(self.Transparency) -- prints 0.5
end)
self.attr.Open = true

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetCh.documentation: GetChildren returns an array of the direct children of this instance.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetCh.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
for _ = 1, 3 do
    Instance.new("Part").Parent = self
end
for _, child in self:GetChildren() do
    child.Transparency = 0.5
end
print(#self:GetChildren()) -- prints 3

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetCo.documentation: GetComponents returns the names of the components on the instance: built-in components first, then custom components in the order the place declares them. The list omits relationship pairs; query `game.World.Pair("Tag", "*")` with World.Query for tags.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetCo.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:AddComponent("Light")
print(table.find(self:GetComponents(), "Light") ~= nil) -- prints true

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetDe.documentation: GetDescendants returns an array of every descendant of this instance, shallowest first.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetDe.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local box = Instance.new("Part")
box.Parent = self
Instance.new("Part").Parent = box
print(#self:GetDescendants()) -- prints 2

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetHa.documentation: GetHandle returns the instance in this instance's handles slot `name`, or nil when the slot is empty or its target is destroyed. A clone's slots point at the copies inside the cloned tree, so each clone of a template finds its own parts.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetHa.code_sample:
-- Server script in a list part. In the editor, its Template slot points at
-- an entry part, and the entry's Label slot points at a child of the entry.
local template = self:GetHandle("Template")
if template then
    local entry = template:Clone()
    local label = entry:GetHandle("Label") -- the copy's own child
    if label then
        label.Name = "Score"
    end
    entry.Parent = self
end

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetHe.documentation: GetHearingSense returns how well the instance hears and the bitmask of the collision groups it hears.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetLa.documentation: GetLastHeardStimulus returns the source, world position, age in seconds and tag of the last sound the instance heard, or nothing when it has heard none.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetLi.documentation: GetLinearVelocity returns the world velocity of the physics body in units per second.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetMa.documentation: GetMass returns the mass of the part's physics body. It returns nil until the body exists, which is after the part's first physics step. On a welded part it returns the mass of the whole assembly; on a part worn by a character or welded to one of its limbs, the part's own mass.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetMa.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
self.Density = 1
task.wait()
print(self:GetMass()) -- prints 8

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetMo.documentation: GetMoveIntent returns which way the character tries to move and whether it wants to jump, or nil.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetMo.deprecation: Query the CharacterMoveIntent component with World.Query.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetNe.documentation: GetNearestPerceivedTarget returns the closest instance in the instance's vision cone and its distance, or nothing when it sees none.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetPr.documentation: GetPropertyChangedSignal returns a Signal that fires when the named property takes a new value, whether a script, physics, the player or the server changed it.
notes: The engine compares the value once per tick, before `Update` runs. A value that changes and changes back within one tick does not fire.
Each connected signal adds one comparison per tick.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetPr.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(function()
    print(self.Transparency) -- prints 0.5
end)
self.Transparency = 0.5

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetSi.documentation: GetSignal returns a Signal for a custom event name on this instance. Fire it with Emit.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetSi.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local died = self:GetSignal("Died")
died:Connect(function(cause)
    print("died from " .. cause) -- prints died from lava
end)
self:Emit("Died", "lava")

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetSt.documentation: GetStateEnabled returns whether a character enters a movement state by itself. Every state is enabled until `SetStateEnabled` turns it off.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetSt.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
print(npc:GetStateEnabled("Jumping")) -- prints true

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetSw.documentation: GetSwingTwistJoint returns the limits, anchor and axes of the swing-twist joint, or nil when there is none.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetSw.deprecation: Read the `SwingTwistJoint` properties such as Anchor.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetTo.documentation: GetTool returns the tool the character holds, or with `slot`, the tool in that hotbar slot. It returns nil when there is none.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetTo.code_sample:
-- Server script.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc:EquipTool(Instance.new("Tool"))
npc:UnequipTools()
print(assert(npc:GetTool(1)).Name) -- prints Tool

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GetVi.documentation: GetVisionCone returns the range, field of view in degrees, eye height offset and collision group bitmask of the instance's vision cone.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Graph.documentation: GraphOffset is how far a graph canvas is panned, in pixels.
GraphZoom is the zoom of a graph canvas.
GraphZoomMax is the highest zoom the mouse wheel reaches.
GraphZoomMin is the lowest zoom the mouse wheel reaches.
GraphZoomStep is the zoom factor of one mouse wheel notch.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Gravi.documentation: GravityScale multiplies the world's gravity for this body. 1 is normal gravity, 0 is none, and a negative value pulls the body up.
GravityVector is the acceleration in units/s² that replaces world Gravity for this character.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GridL.documentation: GridLineColor3 is the color of the lines between table cells.
GridLineThickness is the width in pixels of the lines between table cells; 0 draws none.
GridLineTransparency is the transparency of the lines between table cells, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.GripS.documentation: GripSize is the size in pixels of the square resize handle in a window's corner.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Group.documentation: GroupTransparency fades the element and every element under it, from 0 (as authored) to 1 (invisible), including an open popup, menu, dropdown panel or dialog. On a `SurfaceGui` or `BillboardGui` it fades the whole canvas. An element at 1 still takes the pointer; set `Visible` to false to stop it.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Handl.documentation: HandlesColor3 is the color of the 3D handles.
HandlesFaces is a bitmask of the bounding box faces that show handles: bits 0 to 5 are Right (+X), Top (+Y), Back (+Z), Left (-X), Bottom (-Y) and Front (-Z). 63 shows all six.
HandlesStyle is the look of the move handles: `"Resize"` draws ball pins and `"Movement"` draws arrows.
HandlesTransparency is the transparency of the 3D handles.
HandlesType is whether the handles move the instance along each axis (`"Translation"`) or turn it about each axis with rings (`"Rotation"`).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.HasCo.documentation: HasComponent returns true when the instance has the component or Pair.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.HasCo.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
print(self:HasComponent("Light")) -- prints false
self:AddComponent("Light")
print(self:HasComponent("Light")) -- prints true

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Heade.documentation: HeaderCell, when true, makes the grid cell look and work as a clickable column header.
HeaderColor3 is the color of the header bar of a collapsible section.
HeaderHeight is the height in pixels of a collapsible section's header bar. A collapsed section shrinks to this height; values below 0 count as 0.
HeaderTransparency is the transparency of a collapsible section's header bar.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Healt.documentation: Health is the character's health. At 0 the character enters the `"Dead"` state at the next physics step. `Health` is on the character root, so to hurt a body part's character, call TakeDamage on the part or write `Health` on its Character.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Healt.code_sample:
-- Server script: heal a character by 25 without going past MaxHealth.
local npc = assert(game.Prefabs.Spawn("Character"))
npc:TakeDamage(10)
npc.Health = math.min(npc.Health + 25, npc.MaxHealth)
print(npc.Health) -- prints 100

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.HighV.documentation: HighValue is the step of the upper thumb of a two-thumb range slider, from 0 to `Steps - 1`. Dragging never puts it below the lower thumb.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Highl.documentation: HighlightColor3 is the background color of a menu item or dropdown entry under the pointer.
HighlightTransparency is the transparency of the background of a menu item or dropdown entry under the pointer.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Hinge.documentation: HingeAnchor is the pivot of the hinge, in units in this part's frame.
HingeAxis is the direction the hinge turns around, in this part's frame.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.HipHe.documentation: HipHeight is how high, in units, the bottom of the torso stands above the ground.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Hit.documentation:
Hit fires during each physics step for each body this part's collider hit, with the other instance, the contact position, the contact normal and the relative speed in units per second.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Hit.code_sample:
-- Server script in a floor part: print how hard a crate lands on it.
self.Anchored = true
self.Hit:Connect(function(other: Instance, position: vector, normal: vector, speed: number)
    if speed > 20 then
        print(other.Name, math.round(speed))
    end
end)

local crate = Instance.new("Part")
crate.Name = "Crate"
crate.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
crate.Parent = game.World

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.HitSl.documentation: HitSlopBottom is how many points below the element's box the pointer still hits it, without changing drawing or layout; values below 0 count as 0. Writing it adds the `UIHitSlop` component.
HitSlopLeft is how many points left of the element's box the pointer still hits it; see HitSlopBottom for behavior.
HitSlopRight is how many points right of the element's box the pointer still hits it; see HitSlopBottom for behavior.
HitSlopTop is how many points above the element's box the pointer still hits it; see HitSlopBottom for behavior.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Hover.documentation: HoverImage is the asset id of the image shown in place of `Image` while the pointer is over the element and not pressing it. `"0"` keeps `Image`.

Hovered fires on the client with true when a pointer enters this control and false when it leaves.

Read only at runtime.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Hover.code_sample:
-- Client script.
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = game.Overlay
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Parent = screen

button.Hovered:Connect(function(entered)
    button.TextTransparency = if entered then 0 else 0.3
end)

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Hue.documentation: Hue is the hue picked in a color picker, from 0 to 1 around the color wheel: red through green and blue back to red. Values outside 0 to 1 wrap.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.IconA.documentation: IconAlign is the side of the text the icon goes on: `"Left"`, `"Right"`, `"Top"` or `"Bottom"`.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.IconG.documentation: IconGap is the gap in pixels between the icon and the text.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.IconS.documentation: IconSize is the width and height in pixels of the icon.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Image.documentation: Image is the asset id of the image drawn over the element's box. `"0"` draws none.
ImageColor3 tints the image: each pixel is multiplied by this color.
ImageRectOffset is the top-left corner, in texture pixels, of the region of the texture the image shows. With ImageRectSize it picks one sprite of a sprite sheet.
ImageRectSize is the size, in texture pixels, of the region of the texture the image shows. A zero side shows the whole texture.
ImageRotation turns the image clockwise by this many degrees about the element's center. Layout, clicks and children do not turn.
ImageTransparency is the transparency of the image, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible).

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Inden.documentation: Indent is how far, in pixels, each level of a tree view moves its children to the right.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Induc.documentation: InducedDragFactor is the drag coefficient a wing adds per squared lift coefficient: `C_D = ZeroLiftDrag + InducedDragFactor * C_L ^ 2`.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Inner.documentation: InnerAngle is the half-angle, in radians from 0 to 1.57, of the fully lit center of a spotlight. Between `InnerAngle` and OuterAngle the light fades to nothing.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Inset.documentation: InsetEdge is the screen edge this element keeps clear for elements that set ScreenInsets: `"Top"`, `"Right"`, `"Bottom"` or `"Left"`. Only a visible element on the screen canvas reserves space.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Inten.documentation: Intensity is the brightness of a point light or spotlight, from 0 to 1000, multiplied by LightColor.

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Inver.documentation: InverseTransformDirection turns a world direction into the instance's own frame.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Inver.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 90, 0)
local d = self:InverseTransformDirection(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0))
print(math.round(d.z)) -- prints 1

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Inver.documentation: InverseTransformPoint turns a world position into a position in the instance's own frame.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.Inver.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
self.Position = Vector3.new(10, 0, 0)
print(self:InverseTransformPoint(Vector3.new(12, 3, 0))) -- prints 2, 3, 0

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.IsAli.documentation: IsAlive returns true until the instance is destroyed, then false.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.IsAli.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local coin = Instance.new("Part")
coin.Parent = game.World
coin:Destroy()
print(coin:IsAlive()) -- prints false

@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.IsDes.documentation: IsDescendantOf returns true when the instance is below `ancestor` in the tree. Every live instance is a descendant of `game.World`; a destroyed one is a descendant of nothing.
@luduvo/server/globaltype/Instance.IsDes.code_sample:
-- Server script in a part.
local box = Instance.new("Part")
box.Parent = self
print(box:IsDescendantOf(self)) -- prints true
